subject: Trump is demanding the new version of the SAVE Act get passed

body:
Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
After the House recently passed the SAVE America Act (the new version of the SAVE Act), the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections , folks.
Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. That's not stopping Trump from social media tantrums, however:
Trump Truth Social post refusing to sign any other bills before the SAVE America Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030926_3&amount=35]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this new SAVE America Act because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, support our efforts to hold the Senate accountable and stop this dangerous legislation with $35 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030926_3&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030926_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030926_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=030926_3&amount=50]

We know the SAVE America Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before November, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=030926_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=030926_3&amount=20]

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126993718/606621785/-1263850006?amount=25&amounts=250,100,50,25,10,5&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.03.09_Cooper-Swing-State-Split_B3_F1_S1_C1_90CL-365DON_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjYyZjgxMi0xNDFjLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9Oqmv_qLhMhUVumZq4v9faoHjcltWx2oOueZAh6g3IE=) **Winning in a swing state isn’t easy, Peter.** _Not when the other side is throwing everything they’ve got at you. _ _Not when President Trump makes you a personal target._ **That’s where things stand here in North Carolina ahead of the midterm elections.** Our election is the most competitive U.S. Senate race anywhere in the country — it’s the one that will determine whether or not we can take back the Senate for the people and break the GOP’s one-party hold on Washington. President Trump and his political allies are targeting me. Far-right PACs and megadonors are lined up to pour hundreds of millions into defeating me. _But I know that we can win._ You see, I’ve won some of the most competitive statewide races here in battleground NC. In fact, _I have never lost a race_. body:

Last summer, teenagers Antonio and Caleb Gámez-Cuéllar performed on Capitol Hill at the invitation of their Member of Congress. While they were in DC, they visited the White House.
Less than a year later, they had been detained and unjustly put in ICE custody.
Caleb and his parents, along with a younger brother, were at the Dilley detention center in South Texas for more than a week. Antonio wasn’t with them — he’s 18, and had been taken to a different detention center for adults.
I visited Dilley today with some of my fellow House Democrats, and I am so relieved to be able to say that the entire Gámez-Cuéllar family is coming home.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/2CmNGxwjzkeyTE56Z9IbMw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/2CmNGxwjzkeyTE56Z9IbMw2]
The Gámez-Cuéllar family followed the rules. They came into the country at a border crossing in Brownsville and claimed asylum. They attended court dates and check-ins.
ICE detained them anyway — like so many others.
Donald Trump and Stephen Miller are asking us to believe their brutal immigration enforcement regime is about deporting criminals. Instead, we have to trust our own eyes and ears: It’s not about crime. It’s about cruelty.
I will not stop fighting to end mass detention and shut down the horrific detention centers that are profiting from human rights abuses. Today is a reminder that these fights can be won.
If you’re with me, please add your name today to say you’ll keep fighting. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/2CmNGxwjzkeyTE56Z9IbMw2]
SIGN ON [https://secure.ngpvan.com/2CmNGxwjzkeyTE56Z9IbMw2]
Thank you.

| | | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

WATCH MY SHORT 50 SECOND MESSAGE ON WES MOORE'S NEW EDUCATION IG
|
### Wes Moore is blocking oversight by hiring his own lawyer as his next Education Inspector General. Many Maryland residents are having to choose the payment plan option for their car registration. Meanwhile, _Maryland voters will begin casting their votes in less than 10 weeks._ I need YOU to say No Moore!
,
The money pouring into Maryland's government, including the education department has been questionably spent. Where is this money going? With Baltimore City schools ranking as some of the worst in the nation, it is certainly not going toward making our students the best in the world. And now, Governor Moore has appointed his own lawyer as his Education IG to seemingly block transparency with his conflict of interest. Where's the accountability in that?

Wes Moore has more than proven his lack of ability for transparency and accountability when it comes to the Maryland budget. $2 billion in deficit, $4 billion structural deficit set to accrue over the next four years, rising taxes, and insane fees that no Marylander can sustain. This is why Maryland is now offering a "payment plan" for car registrations._ This is unsustainable!_

As your governor, I will bring immediate accountability and transparency to the Maryland budget. Marylanders should not be paying crushing fees and taxes. And we deserve to know _exactly_ where our tax money is going.

Maryland cannot endure another four years of Wes Moore and his administration. Please donate anything you can to help me today. I must reach approximately 120,000 Republican voters with my message** _ in the next 9 weeks_**, who will request a mail in ballot this election. Your donation will go directly to helping us send our message to them and ask them to join us for _**NO MOORE.**_

Your urgent [$50, $100, $250, $500 or even a max donation of $6000 ](https://dancoxforgovernor.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=2024af94d9&e=5bb5efcda7)will help us raise early money to defeat Wes Moore and _**reach every mail in ballot voter before they vote in less than 10 weeks.**_

Thank you, , for your support and generosity. Maryland depends on you in this fight.

For Strong Families, Strong Homes, and a Strong Maryland,

Dan Cox, Republican Candidate for Governor of Maryland

# Upcoming Volunteer Opportunities!
Adelita for Congress Newsletter
---
| | Hi Peter,

First off, on behalf of Team Grijalva, we wanted to thank everyone who showed up this weekend. We collected **hundreds of signatures** for Adelita Grijalva and many other amazing candidates running for office. **GREAT WORK** out there!
---
[|
---](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=b6ed60a19a&e=f7c3700ccb)
| | Next weekend we are building up for an **EVEN BIGGER** event to make sure we can support these **AMAZING** candidates to get them back on the ballot this year.
Join **Congresswoman Grijalva** this **Saturday, March 14th** , to knock doors, talk to voters, and collect even more signatures to send a **FIGHTER** back to Congress!
---
[|
---](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=69c1fc968c&e=f7c3700ccb)
| | Can’t make it to HQ this Saturday morning? Make sure you are available next **Saturday, March 21st** for the **LAST CANVASS** before signatures are due.
Sign up [**HERE**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=fffcf92953&e=f7c3700ccb)**:**
[**Saturday, March 14 at 8:30 AM**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=f86489d6ab&e=f7c3700ccb)[**@ Campaign HQ (2720 East Broadway BLVD)**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=94edc1e4c8&e=f7c3700ccb)[**Saturday, March 21 at 8:30 AM**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=7a0a97ad82&e=f7c3700ccb)[**@ Campaign HQ (2720 East Broadway BLVD)**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=1ffafde859&e=f7c3700ccb)
Hope to **SEE YOU THERE!**
---
| [SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=9835105157&e=f7c3700ccb)
---
| | As the signature deadline approaches, we want to make sure other **amazing candidates **can make it on the ballot as well. Click [**HERE**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=3bd93d00e5&e=f7c3700ccb) to sign for your favorite local and state representatives!
Adelita recommends signing for **Representatives Betty Villegas & Stephanie Stahl Hamilton, and State Senator Rosanna Gabaldón** if you are in their districts!

---
| [SIGN THE PETITION](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=4133cb4b84&e=f7c3700ccb)
---
| | If you are not able to volunteer and would like to donate to our grassroots re-election campaign, click****[**here**](https://adelitaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4efffbdef3b238a45f56f3bb2&id=7c00d42d15&e=f7c3700ccb) to contribute.
Our campaign is fueled by even the smallest donations so please contribute today. Every dollar **helps support our outstanding volunteers** with the supplies, food, and fuel they need to send **ADELITA back to Congress**.
The fight starts right here, right now!

Thanks all,
Team Grijalva

When I moved to Charleston over 15 years ago, I actually thought of Lindsey as a statesman.
I didn’t agree with him on policy, but I thought he had some integrity.
Now? I can barely stomach watching him speak. He’s the embodiment of everything that’s wrong with the Republican Party – spineless, shameless, and completely out of touch.
He stands for nothing. _That’s the opposite of me._
I’m a pediatrician and a mom. I’m not a career politician. I’m running for Senate because I know exactly why I’m here: to fight for kids, healthcare, for our future.
**I know tough fights, and even if the path is hard, I believe Lindsey Graham has to be held accountable. He doesn’t deserve a free pass back to D.C. for six more years.**

## Oil Tops $100 as Iran War Chokes Global Supply
Oil prices [spiked near $120 a barrel](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCnMZ2RvQacFC7-hi5_eyXa2GvYk8HIOEF5-xP3CtdMM9I30nw9pgdy4m3-jyu5GvO00XkkqpXKlDnVvB9aqdfmE_JK4YnzjPMECgapjNRqCsjpM3VNcJEIyDTktLVGGwu2bxbXDYAw2MH3OurYgblbc9eR0N9sj11s2F2aMlpppWwPbbjFZ-jpHqPp0SojOkWBay7td-atLhTTJ7-ptD6vTXJLrfshzD8Bo4DxPM_Wb09_lQLGixYwKnPFTcDoyyuQzJzkXtjTIWsO-JFccJMnlnapa2qKC_vJKfExWNGpeUVOv2v1Txe9HfwEAAD__34bd7Q) overnight Sunday before pulling back Monday, closing around $95 for U.S. crude and just under $99 for the global benchmark, as the Iran war, now in its 11th day, continues to choke traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, where roughly 20% of the world's oil supply passes. It was the first time crude topped $100 since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Gas prices at home surged 16% in a single week, with the national average hitting [$3.48 a gallon](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykj7FuwyAQQL_G3mIdhwnOwNAlW7p2RGdzkKuwsQxNlL-v0l_o_t6T3tfN30iybOmTVnYtFr_xs2ZujQ9fJLeyVwXwsy2ZZOUwU0qUPAKeT6BPCnwgyS8_9sFFZmTds1PWaqUtWtPfXTDWsJl4vCyoaTpzgHmccKRZGZwvqhf3roFWoACswSFMcQ6GLzFqQxZ0NwIHaeUYvots7c4xv8qDj2Epa5_dvbW9dvqjw2uH10R1P2ThOhDRm-jw2h8u7E_JWerZdiOklST_2e1fyw-HvwEAAP__avhoow). Speaking to House Republicans in Miami Monday evening, President Trump called the Iranian conflict an "[excursion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_upCAUxfGnwc7JFVS0oNjGbrbd0oBc5G74YwBnMm-_mX2FX32ST3K-f577U1OgdP7WEVVzeU_4rgFbw7JnCi1fdQC40xE0RbRGn6c-dw587kH0A-xWU_jsY2eVQ-QoOlSDlGIQksup82p0qI3haM2My7QaMNbhBHKxyzGsQnakvhqIAQYAOfGHXZyxE67OiUlLEGwEtNRyefzNlJpHFz75heVx5NgF5Vu7KhO_GN8Y35pHTyF8N8Y3nyN-DzG-aRspUW1FN8qJ8W2SUszr0rdyx6v3-a7YF7xuE-jQqfaRdCTGt64oe70pBKqzZCOcUdN_v2s_CvZS_F8AAAD__758f8g)" that would be over "very soon," calling the oil spike a "very small price to pay" for peace. The president said Iranian missile launches are down 90% and drone launches have dropped 83%, and warned Tehran against further choking global supplies, threatening to hit Iran's electricity grid and other "easy" targets. [Watch the address here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAUheGnwVusCxiTDgyVqnRo063tiC5wsamwiWxiK29fua_Q9RzpG_7vq71iymkePnAiU2OxM-1rplppsSXlWm4rB7jPPmOaKDgcBhysANGfQJ442IApP2zXBBOJBMmGDNdacqmFVs1o0AdUWvW9CuQcj9pL7_xZd57zHn1okjk0kBw4gFaiDefogqKnGKVCDZJ1QCHVsrQ_Jc11pJgfZaOl9WVqshlrva1MPjNxYeKy73v7KPd6d3T8x4LVj0xeNiZfPrcv-z5tr6c3aBYTbnvKOa29Zh0ME6b8R9Z_ddiM-A0AAP__J8dwrA).
## Trump Offers Asylum to Iranian Soccer Players
President Trump offered asylum Monday to members of Iran's women's national soccer team after players were seen [flashing distress signals](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAQRU9jd14NNuBQuEhDt2lTosEew0Q2XoF3V9w-IldI_fSf9N_3fbojJ96WL8zkaizTRu8jUa20T4VTLY-jAXhuPiFnCjMuCy6TBt0rMKqBKSCnc2plcJFIk5HkGmtNY6y2nVydn7XvBx_B6KEFD4Rk4uzJm55w7qJkd9nANNAA2E7fwkecQ0dDjKZDC0a0QIFr2W8_hbe6UkxnedF-8yXL5NZaH4cwn0KPQo91pZVTupjQ41oyXYeEHjMFRqHHztp2GKziHTf1vrg6ive0q0qYFR5nel5TubvweHNKfPRWtLBk5D-trP_q9HL6NwAA__8A63vq) from their team bus at the Asian Cup in Australia, warning they would "most likely be killed" if sent back. _"The U.S. will take them if you won't,"_ he wrote to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese. ([See the Truth Social post here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u8yAUxvGrgS3R4cMQDwyv9MpbOlXqaGFzsKmwseAkUe6-cm-h6_NIv-H_dR_vPuW0Lx9-Q0exjDu-WkYirGNJmcrRBMBjn7NPG4bJL4tfRgnSXEBdBIzBp_weNQ8uIkpUHJ2wVgllpe346nSnhAmzQTsFfcM-mjkqHY2GSUUxS57cqYESIABsJ6_hFqfQYR-j6rwFxTRgSFTq9buknVaM-V2eWK9z2Xh2K9HRmPrH5MDkQPVBaytz8vn8z1FDRZ__l93n8Fkf28HkcJRGjclBCCP63mgwytx6aUzPqwvHK-WcmrFMw7L59Etx-lOfp5M_AQAA__-6-XZu).) Five players had already escaped their team hotel and were taken to a safe house by Australian police. Trump later said Albanese "is on it." The team arrived in Australia in late February. Days later, the U.S. and Israel launched strikes on Iran, stranding the players in a country now at war. Before their March 2 opener, they stood [silent during Iran's national anthem](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpDAQhU8DmZF_APcGDjYh6003RIVdpmtkbGSbRn37kecKk5VU0ve-9_4_1ydQoLj_gwNN9WmNeJeAtWJeE4WaziI4v6INQAe6DfYd9lVyOTOumOCrAwqfdeyd8YgSVY9GaK2E0lJP_cuMXs0SNoBJWaln7iathBXCz-AsukdPptG4Elxwric5uIff3IR_vFcTaK66kaOjmvLwlSjWF_rwSW_Mg01HH8yr1rN06m8nl04u930PdiutRft3cmlnJxfKENkNmd3pwFhYSdZiZhXhYHCVmiEQMHdtGzpWM7TAwqAQRGavk0WolCIEBk2hgfts3HlTCFRm3Y18P4DCj1T91ZJvI78DAAD__xqVifs). State TV back home branded them traitors. In later matches, they sang and saluted, raising fears they'd been coerced by regime minders. On Sunday, fans surrounded the team bus chanting, _"Save our girls."_
## What Travelers Left Behind in 2025
Unclaimed Baggage, the nation's only retailer of lost airline luggage, released its annual _[Found Report](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OnDAUxfGngc7IH4BJ4SIN3aRNiQy-hjuxMbLvjDNvv5pdaV9g-6Ojv35_b8vNYsBz_2MjGPJpOaGWAESQl4SB0lUE549zCxYjuNXuu90XyeXIuGKCL85ieC1964wHkKBaMEJrJZSWemgPAxJ6BUKpXnKr-2mbRqUEjHJygxq9btG837gSXHCuB9m5ya9ugF_eq8Fqrpqeg0NKubsnPOkAH17pCbnbUmyDOYiu0qjfjZwbOddaO5_-r4-CJ5Ty3jRyDuih0CtAI-di4yNbZKWm7AqrFZH5gPtB7G63f0AsAkHKSMBsTOfOkCAWFsATW-HA0zHK9gkBcmHfMuyLBliGK2Vqs3FXxRCwjLrp-R4ths9i-hHz08iPAAAA__84GZVE)_ , highlighting the oddest articles found in people's suitcases, including a matching set of samurai swords, a fully assembled robot, and a WWII-era leather flight jacket.

Also left behind: a meteorite, a beekeeping suit, gold-plated golf clubs, a suitcase full of rat poison, and a teak didgeridoo. The priciest finds included $43,000 diamond earrings, a $35,000 Rolex, and a $12,500 Balenciaga leather jacket. The company gets the rare bags airlines can't reunite with owners after 99.9% are returned, then sorts, cleans, and resells them at its store in Scottsboro, Alabama, which has become a tourist destination in its own right. Items are also [available online here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykz7tuxCAQheGngW6tAWwTCoo07jZtSsRlsCfCxrLJWvv20aZMm_7o0_k_7-7uqdA2f_gVbcvVbXidBVvDw1Uqre6nAPjeYvG0Ygp-nv3sJMjxBuomwCVP5el6nmxGlKg4WqG1EkpLPfDFYjZRhXEIyghE8MZjgGiMCWPMUQMn-9JACRAAepBdesshDWhyVoPXoFgPmKjVo_uqtLUFc3nWBx5drCsvdmltP5l6Z3Jicrquq_vzFl9DJid-2LRfVAqdo2Y9zKun8ou0f5U_rPwJAAD__1UFbIs).

"The U.S. will take them if you won't," he wrote to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese. (.) Five players had already escaped their team hotel and were taken to a safe house by Australian police. Trump later said Albanese "is on it." The team arrived in Australia in late February. Days later, the U.S. and Israel launched strikes on Iran, stranding the players in a country now at war. Before their March 2 opener, they stood . State TV back home branded them traitors. In later matches, they sang and saluted, raising fears they'd been coerced by regime minders. On Sunday, fans surrounded the team bus chanting, "Save our girls." What Travelers Left Behind in 2025 Unclaimed Baggage, the nation's only retailer of lost airline luggage, released its annual , highlighting the oddest articles found in people's suitcases, including a matching set of samurai swords, a fully assembled robot, and a WWII-era leather flight jacket. Also left behind: a meteorite, a beekeeping suit, gold-plated golf clubs, a suitcase full of rat poison, and a teak didgeridoo. The priciest finds included $43,000 diamond earrings, a $35,000 Rolex, and a $12,500 Balenciaga leather jacket. The Gámez-Cuéllar family entered the country in 2023 using the now-defunct CBP One app, which the Biden administration promoted to streamline migrants' asylum claims. Last April, the Trump administration revoked the legal status of those admitted through the app, and the family during an immigration check-in on Feb. 25. After Pulido posted a video about the family's situation, U.S. Reps. Joaquin Castro (D-San Antonio) and Monica De La Cruz (R-Edinburg) said they were trying to secure their release. * * *
Nurul Amin Shah Alam was blind. He spoke no English. He was a refugee who came to America seeking safety. Instead, he met the cold-blooded cruelty of the Trump regime’s Border Patrol. Agents dumped him five miles away from his home at a donut shop in the freezing cold. They didn't notify his family. They didn't call his lawyer. They just left a disabled man who couldn't see or communicate to navigate a frozen city alone. **Yesterday, Nurul was found dead on a Buffalo street.** This isn't an oversight. # Election Day Results
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
The Primary Election results are in, and **TFVC is celebrating BIG wins** for our recommended candidates across Texas! In statewide races, we congratulate **Don Huffines** on his outright victory in a four-way race for Texas Comptroller. **Nate Sheets** also secured the Republican nomination for Agriculture Commissioner, bringing a much-needed fresh perspective to the race. Federally, **Steve Toth** prevailed in his primary challenge in CD 2. **Briscoe Cain, Jace Yarbrough, and Jon Bonck** are headed to runoffs in their respective congressional races, as is **Ken Paxton** in his pursuit of U.S. Senate. In the Texas Senate, incumbent champions like **Bob Hall, Lois Kolkhorst, and Kevin Sparks** were re-elected. **David Cook** , who earned an A grade from TFVC in the 2025 Session, also prevailed in his bid for an open Senate seat. In the Texas House, 37 of the 39 candidates on our Voter Guide secured victories, and another, **Stan Stanart** , advanced to a runoff. Notable outright wins include **Chris Spencer in HD 1, Kristen Plaisance in HD 3, Andy Hopper in HD 64, Cheryl Bean in HD 94,** and **Armin Mizani in HD 98**. And **Proposition 3** \- prohibiting the denial of medical care based on vaccination status - passed resoundingly. **Congratulations to all of these candidates.** Team TFVC is celebrating alongside you and remains deeply grateful to the informed voters who showed up and made their voices heard. _Stay tuned! TFVC will make sure you are prepared to help our medical liberty candidates finish strong in the May runoffs._

body:
I went deep undercover — deeper than I've ever gone before. And I did it because the story demanded it. Because the truth was locked behind a door that only someone willing to completely disappear could open.

_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Parler_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by_ _Parler_ _._
---
| James O'Keefe | | | | | | [****](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) [****](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) Dear Patriot,

I need to tell you about what I just went through -- and why [**I need your help right now**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D).

For the past several weeks, **I 've been someone else entirely**.

Different voice. Different walk. Different bearing. Everything about the way I moved, spoke, and carried myself had to be unrecognizable. **My own team barely knew it was me**.

I went deep undercover -- deeper than I've ever gone before. And I did it because the story demanded it. Because the truth was locked behind a door that only someone willing to completely disappear could open.

I traveled state to state with my team. We lived out of hotels. We burned through operational expenses keeping our cover tight. Every detail had to be perfect -- because one slip doesn't just end the investigation. It can end careers. **It can put people in danger**.

This was one of the best performances of my career. And I mean that with full weight.
[ YES, I'LL SUPPORT JAMES AND OMG RIGHT NOW ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
Before this investigation, we were still recovering from Minneapolis.

When the ICE riots broke out, I was already on the ground. While most journalists reported from a safe distance -- or from their living rooms -- **my team and I were in the streets**. Documenting. Recording. Putting ourselves between the chaos and the camera to make sure America could see what was really happening.

**The danger was real. The cost was real.**

Hotels. Equipment. Fuel. State-to-state travel. Operational security.

Disguises. The bills from this investigation have piled up -- and now they've come due.

[**I need to raise $52,000 in the next 10 days.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)

That's the real cost of what my team and I just did. And I won't sugarcoat it -- if we can't cover these expenses, it threatens our ability to fund the next investigation that's already in motion.

Here's exactly what your donation covers:

* [**$50**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) -- helps with one night of lodging for an undercover journalist in the field
* [**$100**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) -- keeps a team member operational on the road for a full day
* [**$250**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) -- helps fund a full day of undercover field operations
* [**$500**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) -- high-grade recording equipment that captures truth and protects sources
* [**$1,000**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) -- helps fund an entire week of an active investigation
* [**$5,000**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) -- supports a full investigation from first contact to public release

[ YES, I'LL SUPPORT JAMES AND OMG RIGHT NOW ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
I've spent my career proving that independent journalism -- real journalism, the kind powerful institutions genuinely fear -- is possible without corporate influence, without hedge funds, and without advertisers who tell you what stories to kill.

We've exposed the Secret Service. The FBI. Corporate cartels colluding to rig bids. **Government corruption at every level**.

**None of that happens for free. And none of it happens without you.
You are the reason OMG exists.**

I changed my voice, my walk, and my identity because I believe the American people deserve journalists who will go that far to get the truth. I put my team on the streets of Minneapolis because someone had to bear witness.

Now I'm asking you to be part of this.

[**Can I count on you for $50, $100, $250 -- or whatever you can give today?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)

We have 10 days. $52,000 to raise. **And another investigation already waiting**.
[ YES, I'LL SUPPORT JAMES AND OMG RIGHT NOW ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
I'm deeply grateful for your support. It means more than I can say.

In Truth, James O'Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

P.S. -- I went straight from this investigation into the next one because the story doesn't wait. But the bills are here now. Please help me cover what we spent and fund what's coming -- [**DONATE NOW**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D). Every dollar goes directly to field operations.

P.P.S. -- We're $52,000 short with 10 days on the clock. If 520 people give $100, we make it. If you know someone who believes in this work, please forward this email. [**DONATE HERE**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D).

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.
But I felt God called me to tell my story. Warts and all. I felt led to speak out because I believe millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.
As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC.

The one major problem that’s been haunting Republicans ever since President Trump took office is getting worse and worse...
---
**_Republicans stare down epic voter enthusiasm gap ahead of 2026 midterms_**
---
**“Among registered Democrats, 79 percent said they were certain they would vote in November, compared to just 65 percent of Republicans — the largest advantage Dems have had ahead of the midterms since 2006.” **
---
[Source: _Washington Post_]
---
If those numbers turn out to be true, the President’s House GOP Majority is DOOMED!
---
The good news? _**_There’s still time to change that!_**_
---
To defy history by SAVING the President’s House Majority in the midterms, I believe that Republicans must do three things:
---
1\. Tell the American people what we’ve accomplished.
2\. Tell the American people what we still need to do.
3\. Remind the American people that the Democrats are crazy!

---

subject: Why are you a Democrat?
body:

Derek, _Why are you a Democrat?_ There’s no right or wrong answer to this question. Everyone has their own reason for getting involved and supporting the Democratic Party. While our team at the DNC all have different reasons that motivate us to do this work, we share a belief in the greatness and the potential of our country and have a desire to restore fairness, accountability, and effectiveness that is currently missing from our government. That’s _our_ reason. **What’s yours?** Maybe you got involved because you believe in the power of the collective and what we can do for our neighbors when we work together. Maybe you’ve experienced greedy Republicans making it harder to access the health care you need. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral]
Hi Friend,
I hope this email finds you healthy and hopeful as we approach the end of winter! My work as your City Councilmember has been off to a busy and productive start in 2026. As always, it’s been such an honor to hear so many of your stories, ideas, and concerns as I’ve traveled all across Philadelphia.
I wanted to update you on some current issues that I have been hard at work addressing and ask for your feedback as your voice is essential to my ability to find solutions to the problems Philadelphia faces. Please do stay in touch with me. I want to hear your thoughts and ideas.
A major focus of mine as the world looks to Philadelphia's celebrations in 2026 continues to be my anti-human trafficking campaign . Last year, I secured $500,000 in the city's budget to combat Human Trafficking and launch the "Red Card Philly" anti-human trafficking campaign. I have held multiple hearings and meetings with stakeholders across Pennsylvania to ensure that we build citywide awareness and foster a culture of vigilance and prevention human trafficking across Philadelphia. We are calling on every resident, neighborhood, and visitor to stand together against exploitation. Please stay tuned for much more to come on this important ongoing project.
This week, as chair of the Committee on Public Health and Human Services, I held a wide-ranging Reproductive Health Hearing focused on improving care and protecting rights. We heard a comprehensive review of Philadelphia's current state of reproductive health care and I was so grateful to have support and testimony from experts and stakeholders across sectors in Philadelphia. Please stay tuned as we turn all we learned into action. Reproductive Health access has been at the core of much of my work for decades and I refuse to stand inactive during this tenuous time in our country. I intend to build upon my work passing the Menstrual and Menopause Protections Ordinance last year with more real protections for Philadelphians .
I continue to voice my disapproval of the School District of Philadelphia's school closure plan . Our students and families deserve a thoughtful and transparent planning process that protects their learning environment and keeps their futures at the center of every decision. In particular, and among others, I have been active in highlighting Lankenau Environmental High School as a unique gem that deserves our support. Meeting with students and community across Philadelphia has been energizing and enormously impactful and they will continue to have my full support.
My work also continues on tackling DHS and child welfare failures in Philadelphia. Last year, I held an important round of hearings that I called for as the Chair of the Health and Human Services Committee. This year, we continue this work by working toward the establishment of the Philadelphia Child's Welfare Commission to advise on family policies and inform the public of resources. You will be hearing much more from me on this in the near future and I hope that you will stay engaged with this essential work to keep our children and communities safe and healthy.
A resolution I passed in City Council this year that is particularly close to my heart was recognizing International Mother Language Day on February 21 . I highlighted and the entire Council honored the brave souls who, in 1952, sacrificed their lives defending the right to speak Bangla (Bengali). At a time when our nation is confronting such authoritarian hatred and ignorance toward many of our immigrant brothers and sisters, I felt it was especially important to publicly honor the courage of so many who remind us that language is about culture, identity, and freedom.
As we await the Mayor's budget proposal and prepare our priorities, I absolutely want to hear from you and understand your concerns. I would love it if you could respond to this email to let me know how you think we are doing and where we should be headed. I need eyes and ears across the City and beyond in order to do my best work.
I look forward to hearing more from you and ask for your continued partnership in the hard work of improving the lives of every Philadelphian. I know that we can do this together!

# **Trump threatens Iran with strikes "twenty times harder" if oil flow through Strait of Hormuz is blocked**
President Donald Trump **[warned Monday on Truth Social that Iran will face much stronger U.S. military strikes](https://substack.com/redirect/a35b200d-bcf2-4d95-be17-25543dd1f8c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** if it closes the Strait of Hormuz to oil tankers, threatening to hit the country "TWENTY TIMES HARDER than they have been hit thus far" and take out "easily destroyable targets that will make it virtually impossible for Iran to ever be built back, as a Nation, again," adding "Death, Fire, and Fury will reign upon them -- But I hope, and pray, that it does not happen!"
Trump framed the warning as "a gift from the United States of America to China, and all of those Nations that heavily use the Hormuz Strait," expressing hope it is "a gesture that will be greatly appreciated."

# **Iran defies Trump, appoints Mojtaba Khamenei as supreme leader despite his father 's own criticsms**
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) **[appointed Mojtaba Khamenei,](https://substack.com/redirect/6ac86d1b-7dcb-4ff5-a596-d85242d84ae2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** 56, as the new supreme leader despite his late father Ali Khamenei explicitly opposing the succession in his will, with expert Khosro Isfahani saying "Mojtaba is an impotent young cleric who has achieved nothing in terms of political life" and that his father "felt his son lacked the experience or capability to run Iran."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6ac86d1b-7dcb-4ff5-a596-d85242d84ae2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** President Trump had signaled Mojtaba was an "unacceptable" choice and told The Post "I'm not happy with him" after the appointment, previously warning Iran not to pick a leader without his approval and saying "nobody would hold power in Iran" without his permission. Trump is reportedly prepared to assassinate Mojtaba if he doesn't meet US demands including total abandonment of Iran's nuclear weapons program, telling outlets the new leader is "not going to last long" without US approval and calling him a "lightweight."
* **The controversial selection:** Mojtaba didn't even win a majority vote in the Assembly of Experts that was supposed to select Khamenei's replacement, but the IRGC "coerced" and pressured the council to appoint him anyway, prompting many clerics to boycott the announcement meeting. Mojtaba, who never held government office before his appointment, was injured in the Feb. 28 US-Israeli strike that killed his father along with 49 other Iranian officials, his mother, wife, and son. Leaked US diplomatic cables from the 2000s called him "the power behind the robes" and accused him of rigging Iran's presidential elections, while also revealing he was treated for impotence and struggled to conceive after marriage.

* * *
# **Gracie Mansion bombers wanted attack deadlier than Boston Marathon bombing, DOJ reveals**
The Department of Justice charged self-avowed ISIS supporters Emir Balat, 18, and Ibrahim Kayumi, 19, with attempting to "detonate two explosive devices" near Gracie Mansion, home of NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani, with Deputy AG Todd Blanche saying "these men allegedly sought to inflict mass casualties in service to ISIS with the hope of **[exceeding the carnage of the Boston Marathon bombing"](https://substack.com/redirect/2cc86148-a7eb-413b-b816-0403579b8c15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** which killed three people and wounded hundreds. Balat told officers he wanted an "even bigger" attack, saying "it was only three deaths."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2cc86148-a7eb-413b-b816-0403579b8c15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **What happened:** During a "Stop the Islamic Takeover of New York City" protest Saturday, Balat allegedly ignited and threw an explosive device toward protesters, then retrieved a second device from Kayumi and appeared to ignite and drop it near several NYPD officers before running away and being tackled. After arrest, Balat told officers "this isn't a religion that just stands when people talk about the blessed name of the prophet" and "if I didn't do it someone else will come and do it," then requested paper to write "I pledge my allegiance to the Islamic State. Die in your rage yu kuffar!"
* **What they said:** When questioned, Kayumi simply replied his motivation was "ISIS" and later affirmed he "watched ISIS propaganda on his phone" and "his actions that day were partly inspired by ISIS," though he claimed to "not feel comfortable holding the Devices" and "would not feel comfortable if the Devices were in the interrogation room with him." Both face five charges including use of a weapon of mass destruction and material support to ISIS, each carrying between 10-20 years in prison.

Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Dear Peter,
If Democrats are going to win BIG in 2026, we need leaders with both a moral vision and a record of delivering results.
That’s why I’m proud to endorse Michael Bennet for Governor of Colorado.
Before I explain why this race matters nationally, will you rush a split contribution to support Michael Bennet and my campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-bennet-fundraising-split?refcode=20260310]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-bennet-fundraising-split?refcode=20260310]
Michael is running on four fundamental freedoms.
✅ The freedom to rise.
✅ The freedom to learn.
✅ The freedom from violence.
✅ The freedom to govern ourselves.
Those aren’t slogans. They’re a governing agenda.
The freedom to rise means making healthcare, childcare, and housing affordable. It’s about building an economy that works for working families, not just those at the top.
The freedom to learn means modernizing our schools and paying educators what they deserve so every child, in every zip code, has a fair shot.
Freedom from violence means tackling the opioid epidemic, partnering with communities to keep people safe, and confronting the extremism poisoning our public square.
And the freedom to govern ourselves means protecting voting rights, defending reproductive freedom, and reforming our democracy so dark money doesn’t drown out the voices of the people.
Michael has spent his career fighting childhood poverty, expanding opportunity, and standing up for democracy. He understands that freedom isn’t abstract; it’s about whether working families can actually thrive.
If you believe in electing governors who will protect our freedoms and strengthen our democracy, I hope you’ll step up today.
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael-bennet-fundraising-split?refcode=20260310]
Thank you for your support, your activism, and everything you do.
In solidarity,
Ro

| | Delegates and Alternates,
As the Eaton County Prosecutor, I have been honored to win four elections as a Republican in a purple county. In each of those races, I have either been the top vote-getter or a close second, trailing only our outstanding County Clerk. I like to joke that she beats me by about 200 votes because she gets to marry people, and I have to put people in jail.
Winning elections has always been a team effort, and I am proud to say that the same team that helped build those victories is still standing with me today.
If we want to win in November, it will take candidates who bring real infrastructure to the table. That means strong networks in communities across the state, volunteers ready to get to work, and a dedicated group of friends and family willing to step up and help. I am proud to bring that kind of team into this race.
In Eaton County alone, more than 50 friends and family members, along with incredible volunteers from the Eaton County Republican Party, have assisted me in previous elections. That has included knocking doors, walking in parades, helping at events, and connecting our campaign with people across the community. Every one of those individuals has already stepped up for this campaign, and they are eager to get to the general election so they can get back out there and help again.
We have also expanded that network across the state. I am proud to have earned the endorsement of more than 150 elected leaders and organizations, along with the support of dozens of delegates and Republican Party leaders. Each of them brings their own relationships, supporters, and volunteers who are ready to help our ticket succeed in November. I am also always happy to connect campaigns with supporters, volunteers, and community leaders who want to help Republicans win up and down the ballot.
Finally, our team has built a strong network of college and young Republicans, in fact, I was recently [endorsed by the College Republicans of Oakland University.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001lRMeG-nIB52bUPs-JArKFZ3FnYhGR6Fbg0mhzTkcx3YD47wA3EDK5iT2ZqmPswboqAs8VoSh5xMb5x1uaBEq0Ia7FBh6zSilErf30pge4WTAAqJy9PHSajqjr6LgjuYq6s3aREZsGXZChCxAzK4kuJSJeJHHYyYEf2fLq3vogjwrprBGolZ351WKFOR-tbgNFGDKR-k59NwEtm-7aDA6rkr4LzvSaE8R&c=x3Zr-gVfrxUX2e3sHhmJ7eQsSePlbV097rGxwV5e-Y0y24zaJib5IA==&ch=pAfGAVqAc-l_Z8h5NrghucF9lVk85g-ydVmKCs5HGWNks_T7XuutZw==) They are ready to get to work for a campaign they believe in and to support candidates they know can win in November and deliver real results. As a father, and as a longtime coach and Scout leader, it has been uplifting to see the next generation step up to help shape Michigan's future.
Delegates, if you are ready to win in November and build a better future for Michigan, I respectfully ask for your support at the Endorsement Convention on March 28. With the help of dedicated delegates like you, hardworking Republicans across our state, and the support of our friends and families, we can work together to take Michigan back.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

clean_body: Volunteers Networks And Leadership Ready To Work | | | | | == | | | == | | | | | | | | | Delegates and Alternates, As the Eaton County Prosecutor, I have been honored to win four elections as a Republican in a purple county. In each of those races, I have either been the top vote-getter or a close second, trailing only our outstanding County Clerk. I like to joke that she beats me by about 200 votes because she gets to marry people, and I have to put people in jail. Winning elections has always been a team effort, and I am proud to say that the same team that helped build those victories is still standing with me today. If we want to win in November, it will take candidates who bring real infrastructure to the table. That means strong networks in communities across the state, volunteers ready to get to work, and a dedicated group of friends and family willing to step up and help. I am proud to bring that kind of team into this race. In Eaton County alone, more than 50 friends and family members, along with incredible volunteers from the Eaton County Republican Party, have assisted me in previous elections. That has included knocking doors, walking in parades, helping at events, and connecting our campaign with people across the community. Every one of those individuals has already stepped up for this campaign, and they are eager to get to the general election so they can get back out there and help again. We have also expanded that network across the state. I am proud to have earned the endorsement of more than 150 elected leaders and organizations, along with the support of dozens of delegates and Republican Party leaders. Each of them brings their own relationships, supporters, and volunteers who are ready to help our ticket succeed in November. I am also always happy to connect campaigns with supporters, volunteers, and community leaders who want to help Republicans win up and down the ballot. Finally, our team has built a strong network of college and young Republicans, in fact, I was recently == They are ready to get to work for a campaign they believe in and to support candidates they know can win in November and deliver real results. As a father, and as a longtime coach and Scout leader, it has been uplifting to see the next generation step up to help shape Michigan's future. Delegates, if you are ready to win in November and build a better future for Michigan, I respectfully ask for your support at the Endorsement Convention on March 28. With the help of dedicated delegates like you, hardworking Republicans across our state, and the support of our friends and families, we can work together to take Michigan back. name: Barlow For Wyo
subject: Barlow For Wyoming Newsletter
body:
Let's Go!
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKC543JANHM1VYN04CG7R788_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| LET'S GO!
---
| Hi friends,
The legislative session has nearly wrapped up, with one final day scheduled this week on Wednesday. I’m grateful for the work that was done and for the many conversations that helped shape it. Two pieces of legislation I spent time on this session are now law. The Stem Cell Freedom Act and the Senate Joint Resolution to Protect Public Lands and Keep Decisions Local both passed and were signed by the Governor. Thank you to everyone who helped move those efforts forward and who took the time to share your thoughts along the way. With the session behind us, our focus now turns back to the campaign. In the weeks ahead, we’ll be getting back out across Wyoming, visiting communities and continuing the Wyoming conversations that started long before this race began. Campaigns run on people first, but they also take resources. The biggest cost in any election is simply getting the message out through signs, digital advertising, and the tools needed to reach voters across a large state like ours. If you’re able, I’d appreciate your support. Just as important, please keep sharing your own experiences with friends and neighbors about why you believe in this campaign. We’ll be back on the road soon, and I look forward to seeing many of you along the way. You can always find upcoming stops on the schedule pinned to our Facebook page and included in this newsletter, which we update each week. Thank you for riding with us. \- Eric
---
|
---
| | | IN THE NEWS KOTA [Wyoming legislature passes Stem Cell Freedom Act, giving access to unapproved treatments](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKC543JANHM1VYN04CG7R788_1) Wyoming News Now - KGWN [Barlow for Governor - On Air Segment](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKC543JANHM1VYN04CG7R788_2) Oil City News [Firearm rights restoration may soon be possible for nonviolent offenders ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKC543JANHM1VYN04CG7R788_3) Laramie Boomerang [Wyoming Sens. Crum and Barlow update Laramie residents about legislative priorities](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKC543JANHM1VYN04CG7R788_4)
---
| | |
---
|
---
| **AROUND THE CAPITOL **
---
| | | CIVICS LAB There was a big crowd at the unveiling of the new Civics Lab at the Capitol last week, which will help students learn about citizen engagement and our three branches of government. My friend Diana Enzi was on hand as her late husband, Senator Mike Enzi, is featured in the lab. Senator Enzi is perfect for the lab, as he was a Mayor, legislator, and United States Senator for Wyoming.
---
| | |
---
| | | BILL SIGNING Stem Cell Freedom Act
I attended Governor Gordon’s bill signing for the Stem Cell Freedom Act, alongside those who testified in support of the bill. It’s rewarding to see legislation pass that will make a real difference for Wyoming constituents.
---
| | |
---
| | | BILL SIGNING Protect Public Lands & Keeping Decisions Local - SJR 009 Governor Gordon also signed Senate Joint Resolution 9 - Protect Public Lands and Keep Decisions Local.
I’m especially proud of this bill, because I have heard and understood how important this declaration is to people around the state.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | YAY - SIGNS!! (Sourced in WY)

CAN YOU HELP WITH THE NEXT ORDER??
You've all been patient, and FINALLY, the Barlow for Governor signs are starting to appear across the Wyoming landscape, with strong backing for the Wyoming wind and weather! Many of you have asked for smaller yard signs, which will arrive for distribution this spring.
But, as you know...we have A LOT of land to cover. Can you help with an additional donation to keep the sign printer moving? Click the link below!
---
| | |
---
| | [ HELP WITH SIGN COSTS! ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KKC543JANHM1VYN04CG7R788_5)
---
| |
---

|
---
| **On The Trail**
---
| | | GILLETTE COLLEGE This week, Kelly attended the Sonnets & Chocolates event featuring Gillette College’s Energy City Voices. Special Guest Kellen Smith joined. A sweet evening of music and community.
---
| | |

subject: Our vision for a better future
body:
We asked, you answered. Here’s how we move forward. | | | Peter,
March 1 marked 23 years since ICE was created. In nearly a quarter of a century, _hundreds of billions of dollars_ has been spent on immigration enforcement. Last year, the government set aside a staggering $85 billion for ICE. **$85 BILLION.** That’s more than the entire Justice Department. It’s more than the military budgets of Canada, Mexico, and Brazil _combined._ **But today, we’re not just looking back. We’re imagining the future we deserve.** Imagine what $85 billion could be used for:
* **Health care** so our families don’t have to choose between a doctor’s visit and rent.
* **Libraries and schools** where our kids can learn and be kids.
* **Housing** that our communities can actually afford.
* **Parks** where we can breathe.
* **Mental health** support for youth.

That’s what we’re working toward — a future where we invest in our communities and our children. [**We have the vision, and we need the resources to continue this work. My fellow Americans - this is your Vice President. Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand? The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill. But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction. So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026. That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT! That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are... - Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024 - Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year - Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course - Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did - Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth. It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too. That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer. And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels. The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot. I say they're full of it (as usual). I believe in this movement. Even though it's early, I have faith that Conservatives who really get it will rise to the challenge and stand with us. The folks who remember when the Democrats impeached our President, kicked him off the ballot, and indicted him in court WILL step up when we need them the most. I'm hoping you fit that bill. We set a goal of raising one million bucks this month from every zip code in America. That's how we can beat the Democrats at their own game, go on offense in every key race on the map, and ensure President Trump has a Conservative House and a Conservative Senate to Make America Great Again. Do you think you can help us get there? Whether it's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up: When we humiliate the Democrat Party in back-to-back elections AND cement Republican Majorities in Congress for the President's entire second term - I promise it'll all be worth it. | | Peter, when people think about Utah, they don’t picture boardrooms or backroom deals. They picture towering red rock, snow-capped mountains, quiet desert skies, winding trails, and places where families make memories that last a lifetime. Our public lands are the backdrop to who we are. They’re where kids learn to hike for the first time, where neighbors camp under the stars, where hunters and anglers pass traditions down, and where small towns depend on outdoor recreation to survive. They’re not just beautiful, they’re essential to our culture, economy, and way of life. **That’s why I’m taking a stand to protect Utah’s public lands for generations to come.** | [Chip in To Protect Utah’s Public Lands → ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127050151/606774128/884136173?refcode=E28698-20260310-RESENDPublicLands-SB-Resend&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDcxNTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjU3MDhmNDgtOWMxYy1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=fUwL2kRDqwNdeNPskNi6eP_9UBoU80pR0uw1TyK5OgY=)

Right now, our public lands are under attack from special interests that see dollar signs instead of heritage. Some want to weaken protections, limit access, or hand control over to private developers who would put profits ahead of people.
**I’m running for Congress because I believe Utah’s lands belong to Utahns — not to corporate lobbyists in Washington.**
As a teacher, a mom, and a lifelong advocate for our communities, I know that what we protect today shapes what our kids inherit tomorrow. We should be conserving our landscapes, safeguarding clean water, supporting wildlife habitat, and making sure future generations can enjoy the same beauty we do.
That’s the approach I’ll take to Congress: common-sense stewardship, local voices at the table, and leadership that respects both our environment and our communities.

clean_body: | | | Peter, when people think about Utah, they don’t picture boardrooms or backroom deals. They picture towering red rock, snow-capped mountains, quiet desert skies, winding trails, and places where families make memories that last a lifetime. Our public lands are the backdrop to who we are. They’re where kids learn to hike for the first time, where neighbors camp under the stars, where hunters and anglers pass traditions down, and where small towns depend on outdoor recreation to survive. They’re not just beautiful, they’re essential to our culture, economy, and way of life. That’s why I’m taking a stand to protect Utah’s public lands for generations to come. | = Right now, our public lands are under attack from special interests that see dollar signs instead of heritage. Some want to weaken protections, limit access, or hand control over to private developers who would put profits ahead of people. I’m running for Congress because I believe Utah’s lands belong to Utahns — not to corporate lobbyists in Washington. As a teacher, a mom, and a lifelong advocate for our communities, I know that what we protect today shapes what our kids inherit tomorrow. We should be conserving our landscapes, safeguarding clean water, supporting wildlife habitat, and making sure future generations can enjoy the same beauty we do. Joe performed alongside his brothers, Jim and Buddy, starting their professional career as children on the Grand Ole Opry in 1948. The group produced and starred in the syndicated TV show America Sings from 1967 to 1976, which reached millions of viewers weekly. Most famous for their gold-selling gospel standard "One Day At A Time" (1975) and their country crossover hit "Still The One" (1982).
Joe and his brothers recorded the original theme song for the popular 1980s detective show Simon & Simon, titled "Best of Friends". Together the group won five Grammy Awards and was inducted into the Alabama Music Hall of Fame in 2005.
His son, Neil Thrasher, followed in his footsteps as a singer and has become one of Nashville's most successful songwriters.

name: Kimberly Fletcher
subject: My husband was at the Pentagon on 9/11. That day changed everything.
body:
My name is Kimberly Fletcher, and I’m writing to you today as a mom. I’m the wife of a retired United States Air Force officer. I’m the mother of eight.
[View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e8225635/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvUXBTOW52YnhxNQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMTA/LbmNsMURvaGFQbA/qP2hpZHM9bmNsNEdGZER2czZRQXZscw/gabBFQw/ses906ed9f1)

| | | | | | | | | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/moms-for-america/mfa-personal-urgent-hf?utm_source=mfa-personal-urgent&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25")
---
| Dear Friend,
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/moms-for-america/mfa-personal-urgent-hf?utm_source=mfa-personal-urgent&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25") My name is Kimberly Fletcher, and I’m writing to you today as a mom. I’m the wife of a retired United States Air Force officer. I’m the mother of eight children. And for the past twenty-two years, I’ve led a movement of American mothers who are standing up to protect our children, defend our freedoms, and restore the values that made this country the greatest nation on earth. That movement is called **Moms for America**. And I believe, with all my heart, that it is the most important work I will ever do. **But let me tell you how it started.** On September 11, 2001, my husband was stationed at the Pentagon. When those planes hit, I didn’t know if I’d ever see him again. I was home with our children, watching the news in horror, praying harder than I’d ever prayed in my life. Through a series of absolute miracles, he came home safe that day. _And something inside me changed forever. As I tell people:_**_“That was the day I went from just being patriotic to being a patriot.”_** In the years that followed, I threw myself into learning everything I could — about the Constitution, about American history, about the principles of liberty that our Founders risked everything to establish. I attended town halls. I ran for school board. I homeschooled my children and learned right alongside them. And do you know what I discovered? A whole new world opened up. I found heroes and patriots I’d never heard of — including mothers and even children who were part of the fightfight for freedom. I felt God calling me to do something about it. But I hesitated. I thought, “What do I know? I’m just a mom.” **But God qualifies who He calls.** And in 2004, I gathered 27 women in a living room in Dayton, Ohio — and Moms for America was born. **[▶ _I believe in Kimberly’s mission. Let me invest in Moms for America today._](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/moms-for-america/mfa-personal-urgent-hf?utm_source=mfa-personal-urgent&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25")** **Here’s what’s at stake — and why I need your help right now.** Friend, I wish I could tell you that things have gotten better since 2004. But the truth is, the threat to our families, our children, and our way of life has never been greater. In the last decade, a radical leftist ideology has swept through our schools, our institutions, and our culture like a wildfire: • Our children are being taught to be ashamed of America — to see our nation’s history as nothing but oppression and injustice. • Radical gender ideology is being pushed on kids as young as kindergarten — without parental knowledge or consent. • Parents who speak up at school board meetings are labeled “domestic terrorists” and silenced. • The Constitution — the very document designed to protect our God-given rights — is being ignored, twisted, and undermined at every level of government. • Faith and family, the two pillars that built this nation, are under relentless attack from a culture that wants to tear them down and replace them with government dependence. **And here’s the hardest truth of all:** Most American moms don’t even know it’s happening. They’re busy raising their families, working, doing everything they can to hold it together. The media won’t tell them the truth. The schools won’t tell them the truth. And by the time they realize what’s been done to their children, it feels like it’s too late. **It’s not too late. But we are running out of time.** **[▶](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/moms-for-america/mfa-personal-urgent-hf?utm_source=mfa-personal-urgent&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25") _[This is urgent. I want to help Moms for America fight back — take me to the donation page.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "https://secure.anedot.com/moms-for-america/mfa-personal-urgent-hf?utm_source=mfa-personal-urgent&utm_medium=hf&utm_campaign=mb&amount=25")_** **The Solution: Cottage Meetings — “Tupperware for Liberty”** At Moms for America, we don’t fight **_against_** something. We fight **_for_** something. And what we fight for is an informed, empowered, connected generation of mothers who have the knowledge and confidence to protect their families and lead their communities. **Our weapon? It’s not a protest sign. It’s not a political ad. It’s a kitchen table.** It’s called the **Cottage Meeting Project** , and it is the most powerful grassroots civics education program in America today. **Here’s how it works:** A mom — maybe she’s nervous, maybe she’s never done anything like this before — invites a handful of friends and neighbors into her home. She’s got coffee brewing and our professionally produced video series ready to go. **She presses play.** And for the next hour, those women learn the real story of America — the heroes, the mothers, even the children who fought for the freedom we enjoy today. They learn about the Constitution, not as some dusty old document, but as a living blueprint for liberty that was designed to protect their families. name: Chris Pappas
subject: Putting a check on Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
If we hold New Hampshire, we stay on track to flip the Senate and restore a real check on Donald Trump’s allies in Congress
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=5503%2E582294%2ELdRpJG)
**If we’re going to flip the Senate blue this November, it starts right here in New Hampshire.**
We have to defend this Senate seat because Democrats have no shot at taking back the majority without it.
_And, if the GOP wins this race, they’ll continue to be a rubber stamp for the Trump Administration’s chaos in Washington._
We’ve seen what happens when Congress refuses to act as a check on the White House. Costs go up. Working families get left behind. And everything from our health care to our democracy is under attack.
**I don’t believe Granite Staters — or any Americans — should have to live with that kind of unchecked power.**
National Republicans are _lining up_ behind John Sununu, prepared to spend whatever it takes to flip this seat. **We can’t let that happen.**
We have a real opportunity to put a check on the Trump agenda, but Democrats have to hold New Hampshire to get there. That means building the strongest grassroots campaign possible — organizing in every community, reaching every voter, and fighting back against the flood of outside money.
**[So, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help us defend this seat and flip the Senate blue?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260310_1.XYmoEN&refcode=em20260310-1&t=2&akid=5503%2E582294%2ELdRpJG)**

|
Peter,
Last week in a press conference aimed at deflecting from the failure of Trump's Iran operation, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth stated "This was never meant to be a fair fight, and it is not a fair fight. We are punching them while they're down."
As you've seen by the rising price of crude oil skyrocketing to $120/barrel today and the real concern that gas could cost up to $5/gallon by this Friday, this does not appear to be the case. They are hitting us just as hard as we're hitting them.
And while Pete's metaphor was a fabrication Democrats on the other hand have an actual opportunity for an unfair fight where we can punch someone while they're down:
MAGA in the upcoming April 7th Wisconsin State Supreme Court Race.

---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Fie4tNkWda7PQdweybfPYiGwGPvEedFp7uuprfZKL6e6ONwYPuB9vsdKoI7xc4o-bSHzD9OjiD6GDPcSQovpuGXCGCd6IDE01lF3rOl3domHQWNp7cxXe8FN-2li0UTKDAbxy2t7x8YOWFgjwVOiL9MsJI65_eMLiI4TWx7rbEjnxT9B8Afg8-hRRZwymIU4MnVnbRa9MA8xhlBM1M_mwnDNW_7d5I-YTPi5UKCTUKA=&c=IEL0xByb47dRV4AJyxlWLlN4ILYY_yTXp5wi19m54IH0ENFS-EwFcw==&ch=QXh9olsIjMMySv6zZMC6-H_fFpR1IZN7jGCTLtCc925JBl1mdzecPg==)
---

Democrats in Wisconsin presently hold a 4-3 one vote majority on the Wisconsin Supreme Court.
This court oversees everything from election outcomes to abortion rights and it has long been a key objective for the GOP in their endeavor to take full control of this key swing state.
Last spring, MAGA suffered a catastrophic defeat when they attempted to seize this court, and then last November MAGA was dealt another crippling blow when they failed in their attempt to steal the Pennsylvania Supreme Court (the Dem win that put Defend our Courts on the map).
Now we have the opportunity to punch them on the ground and ensure their submission by ensuring that Democrats gain a 5-2 majority on this key court. If we pull this off we will hold this Court until 2030. That's 4 years, including during the '28 presidential, where we'll have MAGA dead to rights in a key swing state.

Send your message [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gAMe5vSZekmaVCWflO2yHA2?contactdata=SjUu0GJt2M3s4iq5Py0I2GQM9OybrIp0efd4S8irf1C/IGxWJ8ngRJhVOa+hD7HJOQtwtVEsKTsHFL5EagDDT2YI1oSOOXyMiYSejk8+zlS4fQfFFHMhH7cNRGhMgnHN]
This win came in the context of a deeply disappointing session. At a time when federal rollbacks are attacking clean air, communities, and our climate future, the Oregon Legislature too often failed to advance important legislation.
One example of this was the Climate Resilience Superfund Bill (SB 1541) . Despite strong public support, including hundreds of Oregonians speaking out (from wildfire survivors to faith leaders and local officials), this bill did not pass. It would have required major fossil fuel companies to help pay for the rising costs of climate disasters.
While this bill didn’t pass this session, momentum continues to grow. Our coalition is expanding, public support remains strong, and we’re committed to advancing it in the next legislative session.
Despite these challenges, there is important good news: we successfully defeated all 4 of our Major Threats this session.
* HB 4105 – would have increased logging on public forests and weakened environmental protections.
* HB 4006 – would have exempted select irrigators from Oregon’s water permit laws, setting a dangerous precedent.
* HB 4049 – would have weakened groundwater protections in the Harney Basin.
* SB 1586 – would have opened protected land in Washington County to industrial development.
While we successfully stopped these bills, many of these concepts are likely to return next session.
Budget challenges also remain. The impact on natural resource agencies was less severe than expected, but the 2027–29 biennium will likely bring difficult choices.
Lawmakers also responded to ODOTs budget shortfall by cutting transportation programs that many Oregonians rely on. Funding dedicated to student safety, trains, and community paths was redirected, forcing the 30% of Oregonians who do not or cannot drive bear the burden. In 2027, we’ll be pushing to restore funding for these important programs.
Peter, thank you for all your support this past session. We couldn’t have done it without you.
In solidarity,
