Race Overview:

After Trump flipped Michigan in 2024, national Republicans immediately
made the governor’s office a top target. They see winning the governor’s
office as the key to locking in their momentum in one of the most
important battleground states in the country.

This race has been named one of only five toss-up governors’ races in the
entire country. [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/3167?t=1001&akid=1554%2E181023%2E5xXNJv ]If that’s all you need to hear, please chip in to
Jocelyn’s campaign today:

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/3167?t=1002&akid=1554%2E181023%2E5xXNJv ]Donate →

If you need a little more info on the state of the race here in Michigan
and why we are counting on your support, keep reading...

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Where things stand:

Recent polling shows Jocelyn with a three point lead against Republican
John James, but other polls have them locked neck-and-neck.

The far-right DeVos family has already funneled $5 million into a PAC
supporting John James, and we know others are lining up to pour more money
in as this race heats up.

We’re expecting a full wave of attack ads to try and tilt this race before
undecided voters are fully tuned in, so we need the resources to respond
and set the record straight.

If Republicans flip this seat, they’ll cement control in this battleground
state and install a governor who courts the far-right and rubber-stamps
Trump’s agenda.

If we win, Michigan will have a governor focused on making life more
affordable, protecting our democracy, and ensuring Michigan is the best
state to raise a kid and call home.

What we need:

In a state this competitive, the margins will be razor thin. We’re
building the resources now to compete with the flood of outside spending
that’s coming. The next few months will be critical in expanding voter

clean_body: What resilience looks like in action| | | | | Dear Peter, Nestled in the fog-shrouded hills of Sonoma County, Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve safeguards a rare stand of old-growth redwoods. This extraordinary reserve—home to trees over 200 feet tall and more than 1,600 years old —shows what resilience looks like in action. And we have the rare opportunity to make it even bigger. Your gift today will help expand this reserve and protect one of California’s most pristine redwood landscapes. | | | | Expanding Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve will: Protect 200+ acres of adjacent land, including magnificent old-growth redwoods. Support continued restoration and stewardship of a reserve that holds some of the most pristine, untouched redwood groves in California. Provide a buffer against wildfire risk for the old-growth trees at the heart of the existing reserve. Help build climate resilience by preserving carbon-storing old-growth redwoods that help create clean air and water for the entire region. | | This acquisition is a crucial opportunity that we cannot take advantage of without your help. As our fiscal year comes to a close, your support before March 31 will ensure we have the funds needed to purchase this land. I hope you will stand with us. | | | With gratitude, Jeff Stump Director of Land ProtectionSave the Redwoods League | | P.S. This acquisition will allow Save the Redwoods to strengthen the forest’s long-term health and resilience, as well as take important steps in expanding public access to the reserve. * * *
Just about everything involving this illegal war with Iran infuriates me, but maybe nothing more than the fact that the world is being run by old men who will never have to face the consequences of the decisions they're making.
And if you listen to Trump or Lindsey Graham or Bibi Netanyahu and the rest of the people who seem absolutely thirsty for this conflict--one that's getting people killed, destabilizing the global economy, and scaring the shit out of basically everyone--they sound completely disconnected from the reality of how people are actually living their lives right now.
I want to focus on Lindsey Graham for a second, because yesterday he said a couple of things that I genuinely cannot believe a United States senator said out loud.
First, he went on Fox News and said that he stands with Israel and not with the rest of us. That's a pretty shocking thing to hear from a United States senator from South Carolina--not Tel Aviv. Watching a U.S. senator put another country ahead of his own is deeply disturbing, especially when this conflict with Iran is very clearly not in the best interest of the American people. If it were, they'd be able to make a clear argument for it.
Second, Graham said he's going to go home to South Carolina, look his constituents in the eye, and tell them they should be willing to send their sons and daughters to Iran to fight this war.
Every Republican elected official in this country should be asked whether they agree with Lindsey Graham--that our sons and daughters should be sent overseas to fight yet another illegal forever war in the Middle East.
A war that will mostly benefit a handful of aging politicians still stuck in foreign policy frameworks from decades ago, while defense contractors and oil companies cash in and the rest of us get left behind to pick up the pieces.
And somehow, after two decades of disastrous Middle East wars that cost trillions of dollars and thousands of American lives, these people still want to drag us into another one.
Because when it comes to foreign conflicts, the people running this administration are always ready to pull the trigger.
Once again, this country will move heaven and earth for whatever foreign conflict they deem must happen so defense contractors can watch their stock prices go up.
All while American men and women in uniform are put in harm's way and families back home are trying to figure out how the hell they're supposed to afford groceries, gas, or their mortgage.
But when it comes to solving problems here at home? Suddenly we can't do anything.
We can't fix our infrastructure. We can't build bridges or roads or move this country forward. According to Republicans, we can't make sure people don't go bankrupt when they get sick. We can't do anything about kids drowning in student loan debt who are desperate just to buy a house, start a family, or build some kind of stability.
We can't do any of that.
But my God, we can spend billions of dollars a day blowing shit up halfway around the world.
* * *

* * *
And I'm far from some dove who thinks we shouldn't have a strong military or shouldn't use it. I absolutely believe America should have the strongest, most lethal fighting force on the planet. I want that. And I want us to use it when it's actually in the best interest of this country--as I believe it is in Ukraine, defending an ally from Russian aggression.
Yet somehow war-mongering Republicans can't even get behind that, even as Putin continues trying to fracture our alliances and destabilize a country that should be in NATO.
And here's the part that should make every American furious.
The same people pushing this conflict are surrounded by people who stand to make money from it.
Just last month, Eric Trump invested in a $1.5 billion merger involving an Israeli drone company that builds AI-guided military drones now being used by militaries around the world--including systems the Pentagon is increasingly interested in buying.
Donald Trump Jr. is tied to another drone company targeting Pentagon contracts as the Department of Defense ramps up drone procurement as a central pillar of modern warfare.
Think about that for a second.
Politicians are talking about sending your sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, friends, and neighbors into another Middle East conflict while the people closest to the president are investing in companies that profit from said war.
This is exactly how the system works.
Wars get sold to the public with speeches about strength and security. Meanwhile, the people with proximity to power position themselves to make money from the chaos that follows.
And then ordinary Americans are the ones who pay for it--with their taxes, their economic stability, and sometimes with their lives or their kids' lives.
So yes, this conflict with Iran is poorly conceived, illegal, and immoral. But it's also being pushed by a group of thirsty old men who will never personally face the consequences of their actions.
Lindsey Graham doesn't have kids he's sending to war like many of us do. Lindsey Graham will never have to live with the consequences of what he's advocating for.
Neither will Donald Trump.
You know who will?
My son.
And the truth is Trump and the rest don't give a shit about this conflict. What he cares about is looking strong, feeling strong, and putting money in his pocket. I'm sure there are plenty of places where he, Jared Kushner, Steve Witkoff, and the rest of them are making money off this conflict--through investments in the Middle East or somewhere else.
That's what he actually cares about.
And Netanyahu clearly cares about doing whatever he can to avoid facing the voters in his own country--where he'd very likely be voted out--let alone dealing with the criminal charges hanging over his head.
So what this really comes down to is a group of corrupt old men making terrible decisions for their people.
* * *

* * *
The people of Israel are trapped by Netanyahu.
The people of the United States are trapped by Donald Trump.
The people of Iran are trapped by a regime that oppresses them.
And the people of South Carolina are trapped by a United States senator who seems far more interested in pushing Israel's agenda than in doing anything to improve his own state.
I hope the people of South Carolina wise up in the next election and consider voting for someone else, because Lindsey Graham has made it pretty clear over the past few weeks that he doesn't give a shit about them.
And if I'm being honest, moments like this are exhausting.
I'm sitting here trying to get back into the rhythm of work after surgery, catching up on the news, trying to figure out what my life is going to look like physically over the next few months--and everywhere I turn it feels like the same story.
The same old men.
The same reckless decisions.
The same people who seem completely disconnected from the day-to-day reality of Americans who are struggling to pay their bills, raise their families, and just build a stable life.
Some days it makes you feel stuck. Like you're watching the same disaster unfold over and over again and there's nothing you can do to stop it.
I struggle with that feeling more than I'd like to admit--the paralysis, the anger, the knowledge that the people running this country just don't give a shit about the consequences of what they're doing.
But every time I start drifting into that headspace, the anger kicks in.
Because when you step back and look at what's actually happening--politicians talking about sending American kids into another war while the people around them are pouring money into the industries that profit from those wars--it should make your blood boil.
It makes mine boil.
And that anger is the only thing that cuts through the feeling of helplessness.
It's the thing that reminds me these people aren't untouchable. They aren't kings. They only have the power we keep giving them.
These are the same politicians who ran for office promising to make Americans' lives better.
Instead, they're dragging us toward another war while the problems people are actually dealing with at home keep getting ignored.
They get to posture on television.
They get to tweet tough-guy nonsense.
They get to feel powerful.
And the rest of us get stuck living with the consequences.
That's the deal they've been offering for years.
Maybe it's time voters stopped accepting it.
Because if people like Lindsey Graham, Donald Trump, and JD Vance are willing to gamble with our lives, our economy, and our future just so they can look tough and their friends can profit from the chaos, then the least we can do is make sure they don't keep their jobs.
November is coming.
And between now and then we should remind these people--loudly and constantly--that voters are paying attention.
We see the corruption.
We see the reckless bullshit.
And we're done with it.
Every single one of these fucks should be scared shitless about what's waiting for them in November.
Including Lindsey fucking Graham.

clean_body: Just about everything involving this illegal war with Iran infuriates me, but maybe nothing more than the fact that the world is being run by old men who will never have to face the consequences of the decisions they're making. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? | | | Mar 10 | | | | | | | | | | | | Just about everything involving this illegal war with Iran infuriates me, but maybe nothing more than the fact that the world is being run by old men who will never have to face the consequences of the decisions they're making. And if you listen to Trump or Lindsey Graham or Bibi Netanyahu and the rest of the people who seem absolutely thirsty for this conflict--one that's getting people killed, destabilizing the global economy, and scaring the shit out of basically everyone--they sound completely disconnected from the reality of how people are actually living their lives right now. I want to focus on Lindsey Graham for a second, because yesterday he said a couple of things that I genuinely cannot believe a United States senator said out loud. First, he went on Fox News and said that he stands with Israel and not with the rest of us. That's a pretty shocking thing to hear from a United States senator from South Carolina--not Tel Aviv. Watching a U.S. senator put another country ahead of his own is deeply disturbing, especially when this conflict with Iran is very clearly not in the best interest of the American people. If it were, they'd be able to make a clear argument for it. Second, Graham said he's going to go home to South Carolina, look his constituents in the eye, and tell them they should be willing to send their sons and daughters to Iran to fight this war. Every Republican elected official in this country should be asked whether they agree with Lindsey Graham--that our sons and daughters should be sent overseas to fight yet another illegal forever war in the Middle East. A war that will mostly benefit a handful of aging politicians still stuck in foreign policy frameworks from decades ago, while defense contractors and oil companies cash in and the rest of us get left behind to pick up the pieces. And somehow, after two decades of disastrous Middle East wars that cost trillions of dollars and thousands of American lives, these people still want to drag us into another one. Because when it comes to foreign conflicts, the people running this administration are always ready to pull the trigger. Once again, this country will move heaven and earth for whatever foreign conflict they deem must happen so defense contractors can watch their stock prices go up. All while American men and women in uniform are put in harm's way and families back home are trying to figure out how the hell they're supposed to afford groceries, gas, or their mortgage. But when it comes to solving problems here at home? Suddenly we can't do anything. We can't fix our infrastructure. We can't build bridges or roads or move this country forward. According to Republicans, we can't make sure people don't go bankrupt when they get sick. We can't do anything about kids drowning in student loan debt who are desperate just to buy a house, start a family, or build some kind of stability. We can't do any of that. But my God, we can spend billions of dollars a day blowing shit up halfway around the world. And I'm far from some dove who thinks we shouldn't have a strong military or shouldn't use it. I absolutely believe America should have the strongest, most lethal fighting force on the planet. I want that. And I want us to use it when it's actually in the best interest of this country--as I believe it is in Ukraine, defending an ally from Russian aggression. Yet somehow war-mongering Republicans can't even get behind that, even as Putin continues trying to fracture our alliances and destabilize a country that should be in NATO. And here's the part that should make every American furious. The same people pushing this conflict are surrounded by people who stand to make money from it. Just last month, Eric Trump invested in a $1.5 billion merger involving an Israeli drone company that builds AI-guided military drones now being used by militaries around the world--including systems the Pentagon is increasingly interested in buying. Donald Trump Jr. is tied to another drone company targeting Pentagon contracts as the Department of Defense ramps up drone procurement as a central pillar of modern warfare. Think about that for a second. Politicians are talking about sending your sons and daughters, brothers and sisters, friends, and neighbors into another Middle East conflict while the people closest to the president are investing in companies that profit from said war. This is exactly how the system works. Wars get sold to the public with speeches about strength and security. Meanwhile, the people with proximity to power position themselves to make money from the chaos that follows. And then ordinary Americans are the ones who pay for it--with their taxes, their economic stability, and sometimes with their lives or their kids' lives. So yes, this conflict with Iran is poorly conceived, illegal, and immoral. But it's also being pushed by a group of thirsty old men who will never personally face the consequences of their actions. Lindsey Graham doesn't have kids he's sending to war like many of us do. Lindsey Graham will never have to live with the consequences of what he's advocating for. Neither will Donald Trump. You know who will? My son. And the truth is Trump and the rest don't give a shit about this conflict. What he cares about is looking strong, feeling strong, and putting money in his pocket. I'm sure there are plenty of places where he, Jared Kushner, Steve Witkoff, and the rest of them are making money off this conflict--through investments in the Middle East or somewhere else. That's what he actually cares about. And Netanyahu clearly cares about doing whatever he can to avoid facing the voters in his own country--where he'd very likely be voted out--let alone dealing with the criminal charges hanging over his head. So what this really comes down to is a group of corrupt old men making terrible decisions for their people. * The people of Israel are trapped by Netanyahu. The people of the United States are trapped by Donald Trump. The people of Iran are trapped by a regime that oppresses them. And the people of South Carolina are trapped by a United States senator who seems far more interested in pushing Israel's agenda than in doing anything to improve his own state. I hope the people of South Carolina wise up in the next election and consider voting for someone else, because Lindsey Graham has made it pretty clear over the past few weeks that he doesn't give a shit about them. And if I'm being honest, moments like this are exhausting. I'm sitting here trying to get back into the rhythm of work after surgery, catching up on the news, trying to figure out what my life is going to look like physically over the next few months--and everywhere I turn it feels like the same story. The same old men. The same reckless decisions. The same people who seem completely disconnected from the day-to-day reality of Americans who are struggling to pay their bills, raise their families, and just build a stable life. Some days it makes you feel stuck. Like you're watching the same disaster unfold over and over again and there's nothing you can do to stop it. I struggle with that feeling more than I'd like to admit--the paralysis, the anger, the knowledge that the people running this country just don't give a shit about the consequences of what they're doing. But every time I start drifting into that headspace, the anger kicks in. Because when you step back and look at what's actually happening--politicians talking about sending American kids into another war while the people around them are pouring money into the industries that profit from those wars--it should make your blood boil. It makes mine boil. And that anger is the only thing that cuts through the feeling of helplessness. It's the thing that reminds me these people aren't untouchable. They aren't kings. They only have the power we keep giving them. These are the same politicians who ran for office promising to make Americans' lives better. Instead, they're dragging us toward another war while the problems people are actually dealing with at home keep getting ignored. They get to posture on television. They get to tweet tough-guy nonsense. They get to feel powerful. And the rest of us get stuck living with the consequences. That's the deal they've been offering for years. Maybe it's time voters stopped accepting it. Because if people like Lindsey Graham, Donald Trump, and JD Vance are willing to gamble with our lives, our economy, and our future just so they can look tough and their friends can profit from the chaos, then the least we can do is make sure they don't keep their jobs. November is coming. And between now and then we should remind these people--loudly and constantly--that voters are paying attention. We see the corruption. We see the reckless bullshit. And we're done with it. Every single one of these fucks should be scared shitless about what's waiting for them in November. Including Lindsey fucking Graham. subject: Leadership shouldn't feel like chaos

body:
Exhausted by the drama? Read this:

Peter,

**Donald Trump brings drama, and he has made our politics exhausting.**

It feels like every day brings a new outrageous comment, a new escalation, a new military strike, or a new fight that pulls the country further apart.

People are left wondering what the President will do with our allies, which policy he might tear down next, or what sudden move could disrupt their daily lives. That constant uncertainty isn't a strength — and it isn't leadership.

Leadership should steady a country, not keep it on edge. Gov. Andy Beshear represents something very different. He doesn't bring the drama, and you shouldn't expect it from him. His belief is simple: **to govern, you focus on the people you’re serving, put your head down, and get the job done.** There's no need for fanfare or outbursts or picking needless political fights.

The focus should be on getting results and on serving people well. _And it really is that simple._ The goal of public service should be that constituents don't have to worry about their government at all. They should feel confident that it is working in their best interests, not bracing for the next headline. That steady, grounded approach stands in sharp contrast to the chaos that has defined so much of our national politics under Donald Trump, and exactly what we need from our leaders at every level.

**[People-first candidates are the kind of leaders Andy is supporting, and it's the kind of leadership our country deserves. If you believe it's time to move past exhaustion and invest in something steadier and more serious, please chip in to help power our # [US economic freedom index surges sharply](https://substack.com/redirect/780720d4-95d3-41d5-9feb-4fdfbe64c596?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The United States recorded its biggest annual increase in economic freedom in more than two decades according to the latest Heritage Foundation Index, **[climbing to its highest ranking since 2000](https://substack.com/redirect/780720d4-95d3-41d5-9feb-4fdfbe64c596?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as deregulation and tax cuts under the Trump administration take effect.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/780720d4-95d3-41d5-9feb-4fdfbe64c596?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Biggest jump in decades:** America posted the largest one-year gain in economic freedom since the index began tracking data more than 30 years ago with major improvements in regulation taxes and government spending.
* **Highest ranking since 2000:** The US climbed back to levels not seen since the early 2000s thanks to policy changes in regulation and taxation that have boosted overall economic freedom scores significantly.
* **Key drivers identified:** Reductions in government spending lower taxes and decreased regulatory burden were the main factors behind the improvement according to the latest Heritage Foundation report.
* **Global implications clear:** The strong performance signals renewed US competitiveness and may encourage other nations to pursue similar free-market reforms in response to America's success.

# [Exxon eyes full move to Houston](https://substack.com/redirect/9d856c91-e5e7-42fd-9abb-2195f0739154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Exxon Mobil is actively exploring relocating its legal headquarters from Irving to Houston as the energy giant seeks to consolidate operations and **[capitalize on Texas's business-friendly environment](https://substack.com/redirect/9d856c91-e5e7-42fd-9abb-2195f0739154?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and vast energy infrastructure.

---|---|---
* **Major relocation considered:** Exxon is seriously evaluating moving its legal headquarters from Irving to Houston in a significant corporate shift that would bring multiple divisions together under one roof.
* **Operational consolidation:** The move would bring legal executive and major business units under one roof in the energy capital of the United States creating greater efficiency.
* **Texas advantages cited:** Lower taxes favorable regulations and proximity to Gulf Coast operations are key drivers behind the potential move according to sources familiar with the discussions.
* **Strategic realignment:** This would further strengthen Exxon's already deep roots in Texas while streamlining corporate governance and reducing operational complexity across the company.

Mark Zuckerberg and Google co-founder Sergey Brin have purchased neighboring ultra-luxury waterfront estates in Miami worth a combined 220 million dollars, continuing the **[high-profile exodus of tech billionaires from California to Florida.](https://substack.com/redirect/7399c989-e72b-4ab8-8e2e-f63c5128cd4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **Massive Miami purchases:** Zuckerberg and Brin acquired adjacent waterfront properties with a total value exceeding 220 million dollars in one of Miami's most exclusive enclaves.
* **Neighboring compounds:** The two tech titans will live next door to each other in one of Miami's most exclusive enclaves creating a private billionaire compound.
* **California exodus continues:** The deals represent the latest high-profile departure of Silicon Valley billionaires to low-tax Florida as the trend shows no signs of slowing.
* **Luxury real estate boom:** Miami continues to attract the world's wealthiest individuals seeking privacy and favorable tax treatment with demand for ultra-luxury homes remaining extremely strong.

# [Anthropic sues Pentagon over blacklist](https://substack.com/redirect/dca81724-6baa-418a-8ed4-5a32e4b28afa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Anthropic has[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/dca81724-6baa-418a-8ed4-5a32e4b28afa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[filed a lawsuit against](https://substack.com/redirect/dca81724-6baa-418a-8ed4-5a32e4b28afa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the Pentagon challenging its decision to blacklist Claude over supply-chain risks, escalating the fight between the Trump administration and the AI company over military use of artificial intelligence technology.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dca81724-6baa-418a-8ed4-5a32e4b28afa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Lawsuit officially filed:** Anthropic is taking legal action against the Pentagon's designation of Claude as **[a supply-chain security risk](https://substack.com/redirect/d97cc9b1-038d-4a94-b38b-1284ac557f21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a major escalation of the ongoing dispute.
* **Defense firms dropping Claude:** Major contractors have already begun removing Anthropic's model from DoD-related projects creating significant disruption for the company.
* **Revenue impact severe:** The blacklist threatens roughly 80 percent of Anthropic's enterprise revenue base and could cause long-term damage to its business model.
* **AI arms race intensifies:** The case highlights growing tensions between national security concerns and commercial AI development in the rapidly evolving technology landscape.

* * *
* * *
# [Iran oil shock scrambles Fed outlook](https://substack.com/redirect/333c94fb-96e5-4728-8763-f343eb337259?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Federal Reserve's rate path is being thrown into question after oil prices surged past 100 dollars per barrel due to the Iran war, **[forcing policymakers to reconsider the balance](https://substack.com/redirect/333c94fb-96e5-4728-8763-f343eb337259?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** between inflation risks and economic growth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/333c94fb-96e5-4728-8763-f343eb337259?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Oil price shock hits:** Brent crude topping 100 dollars has dramatically altered the inflation picture for the Federal Reserve and its future policy decisions.
* **Rate cut expectations shift:** Markets are now pricing in fewer rate cuts or even a pause later this year due to higher energy costs.
* **Geopolitical inflation risk:** Sustained high energy costs could keep core inflation elevated for months creating a difficult policy environment.
* **Policy dilemma deepens:** Fed officials must now balance war-driven inflation against slowing economic growth signals in their upcoming meetings.

* * *
* * *
# [Trump signals possible end to Iran war](https://substack.com/redirect/c6ff7457-780d-4f9c-8ba8-cfe3f0bd627e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Trump indicated the Iran conflict **[may be approaching its conclusion](https://substack.com/redirect/c6ff7457-780d-4f9c-8ba8-cfe3f0bd627e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while oil prices remain above 100 dollars per barrel, as professional investors deploy new strategies to navigate the energy shock caused by prolonged disruption in the Strait of Hormuz.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c6ff7457-780d-4f9c-8ba8-cfe3f0bd627e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **War nearing conclusion:** Trump suggested the military campaign against Iran could be approaching its final phase even as oil prices remain extremely elevated.
* **Oil stays above 100:** Brent crude continues trading in triple-digit territory despite de-escalation signals from the White House.
* **Hormuz disruption lingers:** **[Tanker traffic](https://substack.com/redirect/78e929a1-04f2-4ee8-85a1-3417644c44c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** through the critical strait remains severely restricted even as fighting appears to be easing.
* **Investor playbook shifts:** Hedge funds and energy traders are using new tactics to profit from the volatile oil environment created by the conflict.

An enormous percentage of the world’s oil exports must pass through this waterway, and it is easy for Iran to block it, because it is very narrow, and Iran controls one side of it. This is something that you’d expect someone launching an attack to factor into the equation. Unless, of course, they were an idiot. So now oil prices are surging, the risk of global recession has increased dramatically, and Trump still can’t give us a straight reason why he he attacked in the first place. And to make it even worse, he trivializes increased gas prices, saying they are a “small price to pay” -- something that anyone who has filled up in the last few days knows is a crock. Trump is being Trump, and you are paying for it. Every. Single. Time. **[Enough is enough. Sign on, and tell Trump: “End the Iran War Now!”](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta6fdc8ea-2f32-43d5-881b-e3ce90f9f6ec/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi, Peter,Last week I hit the road to meet Democrats where democracy actually happens. I attended as many caucuses as I could - both in person and remotely. Denver Broomfield Adams Boulder El Paso (2 locations)
And I joined Jefferson, Larimer, and Eagle Counties virtually, plus sent messages to organizers across Colorado. My staff attended others on my behalf, and I had surrogates speak for me at even more.[](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=0ecf41f5a3&e=8249791cac)
[_**Because showing up matters.**_](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=a9587c5e68&e=8249791cac)
This campaign isn’t about currying favor with insiders. It’s about listening to people and showing up for communities across our state.
I know what hard work looks like. Long nights. Longer hours. Fighting for every opportunity.
There’s no billionaire fallback for me. Never has been.
My concern about affordability isn’t theoretical. I’ve struggled to pay bills. I know what it’s like to be hungry. I know what it’s like to choose between paying for college or eating.
This campaign wasn’t handed to me by donors or corporate backers. [**It’s powered by people like you.**](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=b0652bafc0&e=8249791cac)
This is my life’s work.
And I’m fighting to continue that work for the people of Colorado.I hope you will consider****[**supporting my campaign** ](https://briannaforcolorado.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e7333941d4549e2ed73aa08fb&id=ed4359119b&e=8249791cac)\- we rely on small contributions, not corporate dollars, and every dollar counts.

name: Autism Health
subject: The Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
body:
** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=7b79935111&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is just 6 weeks away, and we are excited to welcome our community for three powerful days of education, connection, and collaboration. As our flagship educational event, the Summit brings together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to host an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore emerging research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can apply in real life. To view the full list of speakers and sessions, click HERE to see our agenda (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/ahsconference.com%2Fagenda%2F/b43o/De3DAQ/AQ/3e4cc64d-1857-4d6f-8245-f6f836e79009/2/HYvgm5vj0U?mc_cid=7b79935111&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

The Summit will take place at the beautiful Legacy Center Resort & Spa in San Diego, where attendees can book a room at a special group rate of $199 per night. To reserve your room, please use the conference room block link HERE (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/be.synxis.com%2F%3Fadult%3D1%26arrive%3D2026-04-22%26chain%3D27003%26child%3D0%26config%3DGRPCONFIG%26currency%3DUSD%26depart%3D2026-04-27%26group%3DAUTISM26%26hotel%3D31076%26level%3Dhotel%26locale%3Den-US%26productcurrency%3DUSD%26rooms%3D1%26theme%3DGRPTHEME/b43o/De3DAQ/AQ/3e4cc64d-1857-4d6f-8245-f6f836e79009/3/tx4qGnO-3F?mc_cid=7b79935111&mc_eid=UNIQID) or call (619) 782-9155 and use block code Autism26.

To celebrate the final countdown, we are offering a special $50 discount on in-person tickets. Use promo code Autism50 at checkout.

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=7b79935111&mc_eid=UNIQID)

We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. Their commitment helps make this event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community.

We also extend our sincere thanks to our Silver, Health, and Wellness Sponsors whose generosity and shared mission strengthen this work, including Functional Genomic Analysis, Neuro Needs, Microbiome Research Foundation, NutraMedix, Relax Saunas, MAHA Action, Best EMF Products, ARCC Center, Children's Health Defense, myMico Lab, Life Wave and Brain Tap, Daylight Computer Company, Weston A. Price Foundation, VibraTec Plates, Sun Power LED, Stalwart Law Group, Doniparthi Neurogen Academy, Kadiant, Algonot, Informed Policy Advocates, Micronic Silver, SPELLERS, Spectrum Sciences LLC, The Wellness Blanket, Xlear, Vicar Venetia, Sabre Defense Team, Pur Health, LLC, Warrior Mom, Purium, C-Polar Technologies, OxyHealth, Solex AO Scan, Pulse PEMF, MAPS, PatchMD, and Physicians for Informed Consent.

Most sponsorship levels are sold out, but we have a limited number of Health & Wellness Sponsorships still available for those interested in exhibiting. For more information about becoming a sponsor, email us at info@autismhealth.com (mailto:info@autismhealth.com) .
SPONSORSHIP REGISTRATION (https://ahsconference.com/sponsors/?mc_cid=7b79935111&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Join Us for Our Monthly Webinar!

Join us for an upcoming educational webinar, “Tapping for Autism: A Powerful Approach to Enhance Communication, Connection, and Emotional Regulation,” presented by Lyndsy Moffatt, CGC, taking place Saturday, March 21st at 9:00 AM PST / 12:00 PM EST via Zoom. In this informative session, Lyndsy will introduce families and caregivers to tapping, also known as Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT), a gentle approach designed to support emotional regulation, reduce stress, and strengthen connection for individuals with autism.

This webinar will explore how tapping can help support communication, calm the nervous system, and create more opportunities for meaningful interaction. Lyndsy will share practical insights and easy-to-understand strategies that parents and caregivers can begin using to help individuals feel more supported and emotionally balanced.

At Autism Health Inc., we are committed to bringing families trusted experts and practical tools that empower them on their journey. This session offers a unique opportunity to learn about a supportive technique that may help improve emotional well-being and strengthen family connections. We hope you’ll join us for this valuable conversation.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_QY22rz7GTiix3v5NWt4ajw?mc_cid=7b79935111&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.

clean_body: The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here! April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California The Autism Health Summit is just 6 weeks away, and we are excited to welcome our community for three powerful days of education, connection, and collaboration. As our flagship educational event, the Summit brings together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective. We are honored to host an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore emerging research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can apply in real life. To view the full list of speakers and sessions, click HERE to see our agenda () . The Summit will take place at the beautiful Legacy Center Resort & Spa in San Diego, where attendees can book a room at a special group rate of $199 per night. To reserve your room, please use the conference room block link HERE () or call (619) 782-9155 and use block code Autism26. To celebrate the final countdown, we are offering a special $50 discount on in-person tickets. Use promo code Autism50 at checkout. We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community. REGISTER HERE () We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. Their commitment helps make this event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community. We also extend our sincere thanks to our Silver, Health, and Wellness Sponsors whose generosity and shared mission strengthen this work, including Functional Genomic Analysis, Neuro Needs, Microbiome Research Foundation, NutraMedix, Relax Saunas, MAHA Action, Best EMF Products, ARCC Center, Children's Health Defense, myMico Lab, Life Wave and Brain Tap, Daylight Computer Company, Weston A. Price Foundation, VibraTec Plates, Sun Power LED, Stalwart Law Group, Doniparthi Neurogen Academy, Kadiant, Algonot, Informed Policy Advocates, Micronic Silver, SPELLERS, Spectrum Sciences LLC, The Wellness Blanket, Xlear, Vicar Venetia, Sabre Defense Team, Pur Health, LLC, Warrior Mom, Purium, C-Polar Technologies, OxyHealth, Solex AO Scan, Pulse PEMF, MAPS, PatchMD, and Physicians for Informed Consent. Most sponsorship levels are sold out, but we have a limited number of Health & Wellness Sponsorships still available for those interested in exhibiting. For more information about becoming a sponsor, email us at info@autismhealth.com (mailto:info@autismhealth.com) . SPONSORSHIP REGISTRATION () Join Us for Our Monthly Webinar! Join us for an upcoming educational webinar, “Tapping for Autism: A Powerful Approach to Enhance Communication, Connection, and Emotional Regulation,” presented by Lyndsy Moffatt, CGC, taking place Saturday, March 21st at 9:00 AM PST / 12:00 PM EST via Zoom. In this informative session, Lyndsy will introduce families and caregivers to tapping, also known as Emotional Freedom Techniques (EFT), a gentle approach designed to support emotional regulation, reduce stress, and strengthen connection for individuals with autism. This webinar will explore how tapping can help support communication, calm the nervous system, and create more opportunities for meaningful interaction. Lyndsy will share practical insights and easy-to-understand strategies that parents and caregivers can begin using to help individuals feel more supported and emotionally balanced. At Autism Health Inc., we are committed to bringing families trusted experts and practical tools that empower them on their journey. This session offers a unique opportunity to learn about a supportive technique that may help improve emotional well-being and strengthen family connections. We hope you’ll join us for this valuable conversation. REGISTER HERE () About Autism Health Inc. Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. Hi Friends,I’m reaching out because we’re in the final sprint to qualify for **6-to-1 matching funds** through New York State’s Public Campaign Finance Program — and the deadline is fast approaching.My name is **Adem Bunkeddeko**. I’m a nonprofit leader, a son of refugees from the Ugandan civil war, and a Democrat running for **New York State Comptroller**.I was born in New York after my parents fled violence and came here seeking opportunity. Because of their sacrifice, I became the **first person in my family to graduate from college**. That experience shaped my commitment to fight for working families and ensure government works for everyone.As Comptroller, I’ll work to make New York’s finances serve our communities by:
* **Investing billions in unclaimed assets** to create a New York State Opportunity Trust Fund — protecting the principal while using the profits to invest in our children’s future.

* **Divesting New York’s pension funds from private prisons and companies supporting ICE’s attacks on our communities.

**
* Ensuring our state’s finances are managed responsibly and transparently for the public good.

But before we can get there, we have to meet an important milestone.To qualify for public matching funds, our campaign must raise **$100,000 from 1,000 New York residents by Thursday at 11:59 PM.** If we reach that threshold, the first **$250 of every donation will be matched 6-to-1** by the state.That means:
* **$5 becomes $30

**
* **$20 becomes $120

**
* **$100 becomes $600

**

Every contribution right now goes six times further in helping us build a campaign powered by everyday New Yorkers.**Before Thursday’s deadline, will you make a small contribution and have it matched 6-to-1?**[**Donate here**](https://ademfornewyork.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=81a9f685946c3d17fe402b3fb&id=e5ff02c585&e=5702859c35) Thank you for being part of this movement.In solidarity,

Friends, I recently came across an eye-opening story in _The New York Times._ I haven't been able to let it go. | **“Birds Aren’t Just Declining. They’re Declining Faster, a New Study Finds.”** _– The New York Times_
---
Scientists studying more than three decades of data have found that bird populations in the United States are disappearing at an accelerating rate. The steepest losses are concentrated in warm and warming places, and the strongest predictor of acceleration is agricultural intensity.
This is personal to me in a way that's hard to put into words.
Growing up in California in the 1940s, birdsong was the backdrop of my childhood — meadowlarks and mourning doves drifting over the hills before the freeways came. On hard days, I'd slip outside and find comfort in that sound. It told me the world was still whole.
It has been growing quieter my entire adult life. And now science is telling us the quiet is deepening faster.
**A sweeping 2024 study identified at least 14,000 animal and plant species directly threatened by rising temperatures, intensifying storms, droughts, and other climate-related stresses.**
Some, like the Spix’s macaw, are already gone, their bodies no longer able to withstand the heat, air pollution, and loss of habitat and insects.
I know you understand that the climate crisis isn’t some distant threat. It’s here, right now, reshaping the living world around us, a world that must be healthy if we humans are to survive.
That's exactly why I started the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. While people like Donald Trump make it easier for fossil fuel companies and their billionaires to poison our air, our water, and the places and species we cherish, we are supporting climate champions who will fight like hell to protect what's left and restore what we can.
**[We can _still_ elect leaders who understand that saving the birds means saving ourselves — leaders who will stand up to Big Oil and push for the policies that give our natural world a fighting chance. clean_body: | Friends, I recently came across an eye-opening story in The New York Times. I haven't been able to let it go. | “Birds Aren’t Just Declining. They’re Declining Faster, a New Study Finds.” – The New York Times Scientists studying more than three decades of data have found that bird populations in the United States are disappearing at an accelerating rate. The steepest losses are concentrated in warm and warming places, and the strongest predictor of acceleration is agricultural intensity. This is personal to me in a way that's hard to put into words. Growing up in California in the 1940s, birdsong was the backdrop of my childhood — meadowlarks and mourning doves drifting over the hills before the freeways came. On hard days, I'd slip outside and find comfort in that sound. It told me the world was still whole. It has been growing quieter my entire adult life. And now science is telling us the quiet is deepening faster. A sweeping 2024 study identified at least 14,000 animal and plant species directly threatened by rising temperatures, intensifying storms, droughts, and other climate-related stresses. Some, like the Spix’s macaw, are already gone, their bodies no longer able to withstand the heat, air pollution, and loss of habitat and insects. I know you understand that the climate crisis isn’t some distant threat. It’s here, right now, reshaping the living world around us, a world that must be healthy if we humans are to survive. That's exactly why I started the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. While people like Donald Trump make it easier for fossil fuel companies and their billionaires to poison our air, our water, and the places and species we cherish, we are supporting climate champions who will fight like hell to protect what's left and restore what we can. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = ✊ In solidarity, xx Jane = | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Derek,
This week, the DNC is filing a lawsuit against the Trump administration under the Freedom of Information Act.
**We’re demanding transparency: If the Trump administration plans to interfere with November’s midterm elections, the American people have a right to know.**
In October, we sent 11 requests for information to the Justice Department, the Department of Homeland Security, and the Defense Department. Congress set a deadline for agencies to respond to information requests, and that deadline passed months ago. We’re done waiting.
President Trump has consistently attacked the integrity of American elections, in the courts and on the ground. The public has a right to know the administration’s plans for November.
We all remember President Trump asking Georgia’s secretary of state to “find 11,780 votes” after he lost by exactly that margin in 2020. More recently, President Trump told the _New York Times_ that he regretted not ordering the National Guard to seize voting machines in swing states he lost in the 2020 election. He’s even threatened to “nationalize” elections.
**The fact is, if the federal government is planning to deploy armed agents to the polls, we have a right to know. If they’re planning on sending troops, we have a right to know.**
That’s why we’re suing, Derek: to uncover any plans that the Trump Administration has failed to turn over, so the DNC can prepare for the fight ahead.
[**So if taking the Trump administration to court to force them to comply with the law is important to you, please consider chipping in $7 to the DNC today to help us continue our legal work and holding Trump accountable →**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2026?refcode=em_20260310_6346_fr&amount=7&refcode2=6346_22930333_4En8Zw&akid=6346%2E22930333%2E4En8Zw)

> It would be impossible to overstate the significance of what's happening right now in the Western Hemisphere. Countries that have been shackled by socialist ideologies and authoritarian regimes are realizing there's a better path forward to success. In a sweeping shift that many political analysts are calling nothing short of historic, the Western Hemisphere is experiencing a seismic realignment towards conservative governance and Judeo-Christian values, echoing a blatant rejection of the globalist antichristian crusade.
> With Costa Rica's newly elected president, Laura Fernandez proudly taking a stance that aligns with the Trump doctrine, a wave of conservatism is sweeping through Latin-America like a wildfire in the Santa Ana's on Gavin Newsom's watch. From El Salvador, to Argentina, Chile, Panama, Honduras and beyond, countries are rejecting the authoritarian status quo and reclaiming their destinies through free and fair democratic elections; rooted in traditional values and free market capitalism.
> [Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.pNB-dU34w8zGkGJ9oG1A72tnURcUAEVnXGMN5ElnYs4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=190539146)
> This transformation isn't just a flash in the pan, it represents a fundamental shift in how nations across this hemisphere perceive their identity, their governance; and their complete snub of the globalist narrative currently being peddled through Western Europe. The newly elected leadership in Costa Rica and other Central and South American nations signals a departure from the progressive trends that have often plagued these regions in the past. By embracing a platform that echoes Trump's commitment to sovereignty, economic independence, and law and order, they are positioning themselves for a revitalized hemispherical collaboration with its regional partners.
> It's important to underscore the strategic importance of Maduro's capture and subsequent arrest. The South American dictator now finds himself behind bars in U.S. custody, marking a crucial moment in the battle for democracy and freedom in the entire hemisphere. No longer the bully on the block, Venezuela appears to be taking full advantage of the extended hand of the United States and pivoting toward the fold of democratic nations. This won't happen overnight and will certainly have some hiccups, but all signs point to a remarkable return to democracy in the near future. Maduro's capture serves as a blunt reminder that the dark days of authoritarians ruling with impunity in this hemisphere have officially come to an end.
> This ideological shift isn't isolated to just one or two countries, it's a full-blown regional reawakening. Take El Salvador, where President Bukele has become the poster child for youthful conservative leadership in the region. He has taken crime head on, and his country has gone from having the world's highest murder rate to the lowest in a very short time frame. Similar sentiments echo in Argentina where President Javier Milei and his chainsaw, have been cutting through government bureaucracies at a record pace and replacing them with economic revitalization strategies grounded in conservative values and capitalist principles.
> The positive implications for the Western Hemisphere are endless. For the United States, this resurgence of traditional values south of the border should trigger a significant shift in our foreign policy strategy. Instead of viewing Latin America through the lens of interventionism, it now creates a stronger, and more united front across the globe, which represents an unparalleled potential for growth and strategic stability. Just imagine a Western Hemisphere where trade relations flourish, security partnerships are strengthened, and cultural exchanges proliferate, all underpinned by mutual respect for sovereignty and shared values, the key components for all political and ideological frameworks.
> So, what's next? As we look ahead, the winds of change are certainly blowing in a westerly direction. As nations in Latin America continue to stand up against leftist ideals, and opt for governance that prioritizes the people's needs, we must remain a reliable and vigilant partner, standing by, ready to support those making bold choices to secure their nation's future.
> This will go down in history as a pivotal juncture in global geopolitics. The tide has officially turned, and we are invited to bear witness to this once-a-century transformation. None of which would have been possible without President Donald J Trump and his clear-eyed understanding of the necessity of executing the Monroe Doctrine.

It’s no secret that running a statewide campaign in Florida isn’t easy, Peter. The days are long, and the work is demanding. But I wouldn’t trade it for anything. One of the greatest privileges of this campaign has been meeting Floridians from every corner of our state and hearing directly from people in communities of all kinds. Those conversations remind me why this work matters. Together, we're building a broad coalition of working people and families unlike anything Florida has seen before. Meeting voters face-to-face will always be at the heart of this campaign. That’s why we’re investing time and energy into traveling across the state and hosting events in communities everywhere. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. clean_body: | = I’m being attacked by the right and Trump’s MAGA allies nonstop, Peter. After our ad went live, Fox News picked it up on talk show after talk show. The far-right came after me on social media. And an RNC spokeswoman went on the record to call me a “radical who would rather let criminals run rampant than make Chicago safer.” These attacks aren't meaningless. They’re a coordinated effort to smear me and silence our movement — and to prop up my MAGA donor-backed opponent at the same time. Let me be clear: I’m not intimidated or scared. But I am realistic. When they attack us for speaking plainly about how Illinoisans feel, we have to respond with strength and by amplifying the truth. That means keeping our ads on the air and making sure voters hear directly from me, not through their spin. It means proving that our ad isn't just boosting our momentum, it's going to lead us to victory. And that takes resources — resources that only this grassroots team can build. So in the face of these attacks, I’m asking: **=** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Together, we’ll prove that these right-wing attacks won’t silence us — they’ll make us stronger. subject: MAGA mailers are flooding Virginia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Virginians for Fair Elections
body:
We condemn MAGA’s use of Jim Crow imagery.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260310-301&t=1&akid=301%2E12592%2E4kviSz)
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260310_1.kODnXU&amount=3&refcode=20260310-301&t=2&akid=301%2E12592%2E4kviSz)
This is an image of a MAGA-linked group’s mailers that are going out to Virginians right now.
**Yep, MAGA is really trying to compare the redistricting amendment that will PROTECT Virginians’ right to vote from GOP gerrymandering to Jim Crow.** It’s disgusting, and it’s purposefully trying to target Black voters and turn them against this critical amendment.
Rev. Dr. Cozy Bailey, President of the NAACP Virginia State Conference, denounced _“...the manipulative mailers sent by a MAGA-aligned political action committee aimed at deterring Black voters from supporting this referendum, which falsely compare this important measure to Jim Crow — a brutal system that stripped Black Americans of their voting rights.”_
[**MAGA Republicans’ dirty tactics are ramping up, help us fight back against their confusion and disinformation by rushing a donation of any amount to Virginians For Fair Elections now.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260310_1.kODnXU&amount=3&refcode=20260310-301&t=3&akid=301%2E12592%2E4kviSz)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260310_1.kODnXU&amount=3&refcode=20260310-301&t=22&akid=301%2E12592%2E4kviSz)**
We will not back down in this fight. We will not let Republicans gerrymander away the right to vote from ANYONE in the Commonwealth, especially Black and Brown Virginians who are facing huge disenfranchisement threats from Trump and his MAGA allies.
Onwards,
Virginians For Fair Elections

Colorado bill would require devices to signal when users are minors
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
**[🎉 SAVE THE DATE: RMV Freedom Festival — June 26-27, Castle Rock!](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** America turns 250. Colorado turns 150. And we're throwing the biggest celebration this state has ever seen. Mark your calendars — June 26-27, 2026 at the Douglas County Fairgrounds in Castle Rock. The RMV Freedom Festival brings together 2,000+ patriotic Coloradans, 30+ incredible speakers, two days of live entertainment, and a whole lot of American spirit. This isn’t just another event. It’s a reminder that Colorado still believes in the values that built this nation.
Spread the word & click below to be the first to know when speakers are announced, tickets go live, special events are revealed and VIP opportunities open up! 🇺🇸
---
[JOIN THE PRIORITY LIST](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Sorry folks! No podcast today. But here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Democrats are advancing a proposal that could [redirect billions in TABOR refunds to K–12 schools](https://link.email.joinrmv.) for the next decade, a move critics say sidesteps voter-approved tax limits. Lawmakers are also debating a bill [requiring devices to signal when users are minors](https://link.email.joinrmv.) to create online guardrails for kids, while a Republican proposal would require women seeking pregnancy services to [receive information about adoption alternatives](https://link.email.joinrmv.).

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A plan to [ban soda purchases with SNAP benefits](https://link.email.joinrmv.) has been delayed after critics warned it could stigmatize low-income families. Questions are also emerging about the Colorado Trust after employees raised concerns about a [shift in its grantmaking priorities](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Meanwhile, Secretary of State Jena Griswold faces criticism for suggesting she argued before the U.S. Supreme Court in the 2024 Trump ballot case—despite records showing [she did not present oral arguments](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Yesterday, [oil prices surged past $110](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as Middle East conflict disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a corridor carrying about one-fifth of the world’s oil. Analysts say America’s shale-driven energy boom has [reduced reliance on Persian Gulf imports](https://link.email.joinrmv.), cushioning the impact, while commentary warns that the growing trend of “living your truth” can [blur the line between opinion and objective reality](https://link.email.joinrmv.) in public policy.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, March 10, 2026.
– Team RMV
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado bill would require devices to signal when users are minors](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Across the country, lawmakers are trying to figure out how — or whether — government should step in when it comes to kids and the internet.
Some proposals focus on social media platforms. Others target app stores. A few states have gone a step further, looking at the devices themselves.
Colorado is now testing that approach.
The proposal, [Senate Bill 26-051](https://link.email.joinrmv.), is titled “Age Attestation on Computing Devices.” The idea behind it is fairly straightforward: certain devices would send apps a signal indicating whether the person using them is a minor.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Free to Choose Life](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY BY REP. SCOTT SLAUGH, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Pro-adoption bill heads to committee:** HB26-1105 would require that women seeking pregnancy-related services receive clear information about adoption options and resources, aiming to ensure adoption is fully presented alongside other choices.
* **Supporters say it expands choice, not restrictions:** The proposal does not change Colorado’s existing abortion laws but instead seeks to broaden awareness of adoption as a practical path for women facing difficult pregnancy decisions.
* **Backers argue adoption awareness is declining:** Advocates say many Americans know adoption exists but lack understanding of the different types and support resources available, and they believe better information could help reverse declining infant adoption rates.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Colorado Secretary Of State Jena Griswold Peddles Blatant Lie About Supreme Court Role](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [TOWNHALL](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Critics say Secretary of State misrepresented Supreme Court role:** Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold is facing backlash after claiming involvement in arguing a case before the Supreme Court of the United States, despite records showing she did not present oral arguments.
* **Case centered on attempt to remove Trump from ballot:** The dispute stems from litigation seeking to block Donald Trump from the 2024 ballot over the January 6 controversy, a move the Supreme Court ultimately rejected in a unanimous decision.
* **Controversy emerges amid attorney general campaign:** The criticism comes as Griswold campaigns in the Democratic primary for Colorado attorney general, with opponents highlighting the episode as a question of credibility and legal experience.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[What’s really true?](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** **BY MARK SALLEY | COMMENTARY | MARCH 9** _It’s not uncommon to hear someone say “live your truth” or “that’s my truth.” But, is their “truth” really true? The bible doesn’t teach — nor does common sense allow — that everyone can have and live by their own truth. Yet, many seem to have fallen into that pit. If someone’s “truth” tells them it’s okay to drink and to drive drunk...is it really true? Of course not._
**[Weapons of War: Spirit Over Flesh](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | MARCH 8** _ears ago, Sherrie and I ended up at one of those unforgettable Las Vegas timeshare presentations. You probably know the kind: a free stay, free breakfast, and free show tickets, all for just ’90 minutes’ of your time. Before we realized it, nearly three hours had gone by. The room was dim, beach scenes played on the screen, and soft music filled the air, almost like a Hallmark movie._
**[He reported election irregularities. Weeks later he was fired: Now a Colorado fire chief appeals in federal court](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 4** _Erik Holt says he didn’t expect reviewing surveillance footage from a polling location inside the Florissant fire station would cost him his career. Holt says the fallout came quickly. Within weeks of providing investigators the footage he believed showed election rule violations, he was out of a job._

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

| | | | | | Peter,

**Exciting momentum is building in the 2026 session as three key measures have passed out of committee and are headed to the House floor.**

CACR 24, HB 1268, and HB 1704 represent major steps forward for parental rights, educational freedom, and state sovereignty.

**CACR 24: Parental Rights Constitutional Amendment

** This amendment would enshrine in the New Hampshire Constitution the fundamental right of parents and guardians to direct the upbringing and education of their children. It provides a permanent legal protection against future regulations or bureaucratic intrusions.

CACR 24 would benefit New Hampshire by empowering families, reducing government overreach in education, and ensuring long-term protections for parental authority, fostering a state where Granite Staters can raise their children with confidence and independence.

**HB 1268: Home Education Freedom Act

** HB 1268 simplifies home education by making initial notifications and annual evaluations optional (required only for public school activities or assessments), eliminating mandatory portfolios, protecting families from record misuse in truancy or welfare cases, preserving flexible schedules independent of public school calendars, keeping graduation documentation voluntary, and distinguishing traditional home education from publicly funded programs like Education Freedom Accounts.

This bill would position New Hampshire as the top state for home education by cutting unnecessary red tape, trusting parents to guide their children's learning, and supporting diverse educational needs, thereby strengthening family bonds and boosting overall academic innovation.

**HB 1704: The Public Employee Choice Act

** HB 1704 allows certain public employees (excluding law enforcement, firefighters, emergency medical personnel, and corrections officers) to negotiate compensation, benefits, and working conditions directly and individually with their employers, bypassing unions or collective bargaining if they choose to do so.

HB 1704 would empower workers with choices, improve efficiency for taxpayers, reduce rigidity in public employment, and foster a more dynamic workforce without eliminating unions, ultimately leading to better services and cost savings for Granite Staters.
