name: Tobias Read
subject: We can’t let President Trump get away with this
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em]
We’re now hearing reports that President Donald Trump is considering an executive order declaring a so-called “emergency” to seize greater federal authority over elections.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em]
This is deeply alarming to say the least.
But you don’t have to take my word for it: Our founders were explicit about this. They had just fought a king. They understood that concentrating too much power in one person was dangerous. That’s why the Constitution divides authority and states administer elections.
That’s why no president — no matter how loud or how desperate — gets to override the system because he’s afraid of losing.
As Oregon’s Secretary of State, I oversee our elections. I take an oath to the Constitution — not to any president. And I will stand up to any administration that tries to abuse emergency powers to interfere with Oregon’s voting systems or intimidate our election workers.
But I need your help to keep up the fight in light of Trump’s illegal actions, which is why I’m reaching out today. Can I count on you to join me in this fight against President Trump’s lawlessness by chipping in right away? Communicating this threat to Oregonians across the state takes resources. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em]
We’ve already beaten back federal overreach in court before. When attempts were made to stretch authority beyond its limits, Oregon pushed back — and won.
If we have to do it again, we will.
But defending democracy requires a strong grassroots team prepared to meet the fight head-on — and that’s where you come in.
If you believe, as I do, that no president should be able to manufacture an emergency to grab control over elections, I’m asking you to stand with me. Please contribute today to help us protect Oregon’s elections and hold President Trump accountable before it’s too late. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260309em]
Thank you,
Tobias Read

body:
Gina is running a campaign that’s focused on Texans.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20260310_1_spanberger.cCcXHY&refcode=em20260310-734&t=1&akid=734%2E299639%2ESxPCW1)
Hi Peter — Abigail Spanberger here, Governor of Virginia.
Gina Hinojosa is the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Texas, and she’ll be facing Greg Abbott this November. As someone who has won tough races, I can tell you this: **Gina has what it takes to win.**
[**Before I say anything else, will you chip in $5 today to help Gina Hinojosa defeat Greg Abbott and become the next Governor of Texas?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260310_1_spanberger.diQ2E5&refcode=em20260310-734&amount=5&t=2&akid=734%2E299639%2ESxPCW1)
When I ran for Governor last year, my campaign ran on a simple idea: stay focused on people. We talked about lowering costs, strengthening public schools, and keeping our communities safe. And we proved something important — that when candidates meet voters where they are and lead with integrity, we can win big.
The recent Texas primary showed real momentum. Democratic voters turned out in strong numbers, with early voting running ahead of recent cycles. Texans paid attention, and they showed they’re ready for something different.
**And Gina is running the kind of campaign that can deliver that change.**
She is a Texas state representative, an attorney, an advocate, and a mom of two boys who has spent her career taking on corruption and fighting for Texas families. For years she has advocated for public school funding, flood relief, and good government. She will work hard for Texas families, and I know she will not back down.
Early support matters because she needs the resources to organize everywhere, have team members working all across the state, and make sure voters hear Gina’s message.
**[So I’m asking: will you donate $5 today to help elect Gina Hinojosa as the next Governor of Texas?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260310_1_spanberger.diQ2E5&refcode=em20260310-734&amount=5&t=3&akid=734%2E299639%2ESxPCW1)**

Thanks for supporting Gina today, Peter.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127069184/606825196/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNmJjZTVjZS1iYjFjLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_MgTLs21MiLXOy_Q462KTGVOZXDFwAGp8h2N7899O74=)
**Donald Trump should testify under oath before Congress about the Epstein files._Full stop._**
Thousands of documents tied to Jeffrey Epstein have been released. Trump’s name appears repeatedly throughout those records.
**And yet the Trump administration continues to dodge, delay, and downplay legitimate questions about what those files contain.**
**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127069186/606825198/789508428?refcode=260310&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNmJjZTVjZS1iYjFjLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_MgTLs21MiLXOy_Q462KTGVOZXDFwAGp8h2N7899O74=)**
That’s unacceptable. I serve as the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee.**Our job is simple: follow the facts and demand answers when powerful people try to hide the truth.**
If evidence shows Donald Trump has relevant information about Epstein, then he should sit down under oath and answer questions — just like anyone else.
But here’s the reality: Holding powerful people accountable is never easy. And the closer investigators get to the truth, the harder the political pressure becomes.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260310-5989-footer&t=1001&akid=5989%2E420207%2EKnvzRA ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter, I’m furious.
This is not the news I wanted to share.

AIPAC is gearing up to pour millions of dollars into the Democratic
primaries to take down progressive candidates — again.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260310.61euOK&refcode=em20260310-5989&t=1002&akid=5989%2E420207%2EKnvzRA ]AIPAC accused of covert campaigning as Democratic support falters

They’re targeting progressive leaders who dare to actually do their jobs,
and refuse to be bought or intimidated. AIPAC is exploiting campaign
finance loopholes to flood the primaries with their millions, doing
everything they can to drown out the voices of our people-powered
movement.

That’s why I’m launching an emergency fund to help candidates who are
being hit with these attacks. This fund will help candidates respond, stay
competitive in the face of big money, and keep their campaigns on track so
they can focus on winning and standing up for their communities.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260310.61euOK&refcode=em20260310-5989&amount=3&t=1003&akid=5989%2E420207%2EKnvzRA ]I’ll tell you more, but first, can you pitch in $3 to
support our emergency fund to fight back against these attacks?

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260310.61euOK&amount=3&refcode=em20260310-5989&t=1004&akid=5989%2E420207%2EKnvzRA ]Donate

We’ve seen the kind of damage AIPAC can do before. In New York, they spent
over $24 million to unseat Jamaal Bowman, turning his race into the most
expensive House primary in history. They did the same thing to Cori Bush,
they’ve gone after my sister, and targeted me.

No progressive candidate is safe from their massive warchest and their
willingness to weaponize it against our democracy.

Even more alarming: The billionaire donors fueling AIPAC are the same ones
who bankrolled Trump’s return to office. And now they’re trying to meddle
in the Democratic primaries.

When that kind of money crashes into a race, it distorts the entire
election. It buries people-powered campaigns under an avalanche of attack
ads, and forces candidates to spend time defending themselves instead of
focusing on what really matters: speaking to the issues that working
people face.

We can’t stand by while AIPAC tries to dictate the primaries. Elections
should be decided by voters, Peter,
not whoever can write the biggest check.

Our emergency fund will make sure progressive candidates have the
resources to fight back immediately, and protect the integrity of our
primaries before big money can tip the scales.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260310.61euOK&refcode=em20260310-5989&amount=3&t=1005&akid=5989%2E420207%2EKnvzRA ]If you’re with me, pitch in $3 today so we can send a
message to AIPAC loud and clear: Our democracy is not for sale. The people
hold the power to pick our leadership, not them.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260310.61euOK&amount=3&refcode=em20260310-5989&t=1024&akid=5989%2E420207%2EKnvzRA ]Contribute $3

In solidarity,

Pramila Jayapal

## Trump attending White House Correspondents' Dinner?
Last week, President Trump announced he'd be attending the White House Correspondents' Dinner.
This will be his first time attending; he boycotted the event throughout his first term, as well as last year.
He skipped for good reason: why go to an event that just lends credibility to same biased "journalists" that are trying to wreck the Right's agenda?
It's been a problem for years, that's why I devoted a chapter to how Trump is holding the media accountable in [my new book](https://substack.com/redirect/9367534f-b0cf-4f0c-b280-d5f6004f04cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But now, he's decided to attend this year.
Can he handle it?
Yes.
But I'm afraid his presence is going to give life to an institution that needed to die out.
Let's break it down...

# [Tell Senate to Vote NO on Markwayne Mullin for Secretary of Homeland Security](https://default.salsalabs.org/T424f50a2-af9c-44b5-9a73-5167c3bebbbe/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | _(Quick links: [Go to action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7b361c3c-4363-421b-a543-c1c1f7c7dc53/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) | [Discuss](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1f1d662c-967b-4a25-9b5a-f674ee9acd45/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) | [See other actions)](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0cef740c-0675-443a-901a-7ea1d66eff53/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)[ ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te30d35ab-6bd8-44a4-baf0-ce3da4bc94f9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_ We're in the middle of a war that could easily go global, and we need the best and most experienced people in critical defense and homeland security positions. **Markwayne Mullin is not one of those people, and[the Senate should reject him for Secretary of Homeland Security](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6f870ecb-6768-4983-b553-05a0f19fa014/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9):** _" He has never held a prominent party leadership role. He has not served on any of the congressional committees that directly oversee the Homeland Security Department or immigration enforcement. He has no law enforcement experience, and before running for Congress, he had never worked in government."_ ([NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb015735f-7d47-4b23-9c92-e197a5df5323/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) It's not a slam at him to point out that he simply does not have critical experience necessary for the job. There are many, many people across the political spectrum who do have that experience, and can hit the ground running. Plus, Mullin has cheered on 2020 election deniers, which is just plain crazy, not to mention dangerous. And he's [said and done](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb80cc4f1-89e2-475c-bd55-e34bc4cf6b2f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) some even crazier and more odious things. **There are plenty of people out there who would be solid picks. Mullin is not one of them. [Tell the Senate: "Reject Mullin."](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5b81a80b-1910-430d-acee-07a580823249/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

null,

We hear Florida is lovely this time of year.

Sunshine. Beaches. Palm trees. Not a snow shovel in sight.
**Which might explain why our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, has been campaigning remotely from his Florida mansion.
**
_He even joked on the radio that he’d rather be_ _“on the beach in Florida” while Michigan prepared for a brutal winter storm.
_
Look, Florida is nice.
**But does Mike Rogers know this Senate race is about Michigan?
**
Somebody should probably tell him.

Because Haley Stevens is about as Michigan as it gets.

She was born and raised here. Her parents ran a small landscaping and snowplow business here. She helped save 200,000 Michigan auto jobs as Chief of Staff on President Obama’s auto rescue, and she's spent her career fighting for the workers, manufacturers, and communities that built this state.

Michigan winters. Michigan workers. Michigan grit.

That’s Haley Stevens.
And while Mike Rogers hangs out at his mansion in Florida, Haley is traveling across Michigan, meeting with autoworkers, farmers, and small businesses about the future we’re building _here_ _._

Not in Cape Coral.

**Because****this****campaign is about making sure the working people who built Michigan still have a voice in the U.S. Senate.**

But we can’t do it without you, null. The Senate majority will come down to our race – and grassroots support right now matters more than ever.

Trump-aligned super PACs are spending millions to steal your voice. Robert Peters is fighting back — and winning for working people.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260310-1&t=1&akid=3231%2E587540%2EgBqlR4)
Peter,
Washington is full of do-nothing politicians who talk a big game, and deliver _nothing._
That isn’t because there’s a lack of effective elected officials at the state and local levels ready to lead in DC. It’s because when there is a leader who has proven effective at taking on special interests at the state and local level, millions of dollars are spent to stop them from ever making it to Congress. This makes it so Congressional races are less about who’s done the most to help their constituents and more about who has cozied up to the most special interest groups during their time in office.
Robert Peters is one of those effective elected officials who has spent his time as an IL State Senator fighting for his constituents instead of befriending lobbyists. From speaking out about the genocide in Gaza, ending cash bail, fighting the gun industry, and just last month introducing legislation to protect Illinoisans from AI-driven price discrimination (that’s where AI uses your personal data to display one price for you and a different price for someone else on online stores).
No matter what special interest groups or lobbyists he might piss off, Robert has always put his constituents first. And now that he’s running for Congress, those special interest groups are terrified of a truly independent leader like Robert Peters holding higher office.
That’s why AIPAC, the AI industry, and Trump-aligned super PACs are spending millions to try and take him down.
**They’re _terrified_ that he can actually win this thing, so they’d rather try to steal this seat out from under voters than engage in a fair fight.**
But here’s the problem for them: Robert Peters has spent his entire career delivering real solutions for the people of Illinois. **Voters see that, and they won’t be fooled.**
**[I’ll tell you more about Robert, but first, can you chip in $5 to help us power him to victory before his primary on March 17?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260310_1_peters.J9jxHJ&refcode=em20260310-3231&amount=5&t=2&akid=3231%2E587540%2EgBqlR4)**
In the Illinois State Senate, Robert helped pass one of the most significant criminal justice reforms in the country, ending cash bail and expanding police accountability through the SAFE-T Act.
And when it comes to confronting gun violence, Robert doesn’t back down. He championed the RIFL Act, which would hold the gun industry accountable by taxing it to fund victim services, cover funeral costs, and provide long-term support for families impacted by gun violence.
**Robert is making real, concrete change for his community — because that’s who he answers to,_not corporate PACs or right-wing billionaires._**
And Robert doesn’t wait for permission to do the right thing. He organizes, builds strong coalitions, and pushes bold ideas for working people, even when the battle is uphill.
That’s exactly the kind of courageous leadership this moment demands, and it’s why Leaders We Deserve is proud to stand with him.
With his **March 17 primary** right around the corner, we need all hands on deck to beat the corporate money trying to take him down.
If we’re going to get better people elected to Congress, we have to show that you can remain an independent, principled leader, and still win. Because when the special interests come after you for sticking to your principles, Leaders We Deserve is here to help you fight back with the power of thousands of people chipping in what they can, when they can.
**[So Peter, can you split a $5 donation today between Robert Peters and Leaders We Deserve? Every dollar you give powers his fight and makes sure this seat is won for working people, not corporations.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260310_1_peters.J9jxHJ&refcode=em20260310-3231&amount=5&t=3&akid=3231%2E587540%2EgBqlR4)**

Thank you,
David Hogg

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Epic Fury Hits New Peak

Secretary of War Pete Hegseth declared Tuesday the [most intense day](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLFyhCAURb8GO5zHA3UtKNLYbdqUzlt4uzJBcJTVfH6GfEK609xz79yv-3ynEEN6fdLK1p1h9tnP33QsGxWOlHxZ-PkI7-TyyfuMgL0ELRXMKc6q8db5XmPDVg2DVkOHvW4W2z3IUOe87tA_R-DOILruxiMoQB51E2w1gVaAYBRA6-jGZrwNSnlnhlELA-_NU-GjdTkdvJ9UwskhpVwpp9bltYl2KWU7hP4QOAmcrutqn_nHJL5qbhU4VRQ4hZ2SvGiXsTqLXGl3i1Qg645mt367Qozh6Adh4LVSiH8F5R-fnBZ_AwAA__84W2-7) of U.S. strikes inside Iran yet as Operation Epic Fury enters Day 11. President Trump on Monday threatened to hit Iran "twenty times harder" if Tehran tries to shut down the Strait of Hormuz. This Women's History Month, I want to take a moment to celebrate the courageous trailblazing women who have shaped New Hampshire.

Our state has a proud legacy of women in leadership. Today, both of our U.S. Senators are women, as well as half of our congressional delegation in the U.S. House.

That is something worth celebrating.

But the work is not finished. While women have broken barriers at the highest levels of our state government, representation drops significantly at the local level.

Progress at the top means nothing if we are not building a pipeline of women leaders at every level of government.

That is the New Hampshire I am fighting for. A state where every little girl has the ability to shatter the glass ceiling and realize their fullest potential.

This month and every month, I am grateful to stand on the shoulders of the women who came before us and remain committed to opening doors for those who come after.

Thank you,
Cinde

| | **I just introduced the End Prediction Market Corruption Act,** a bill that bans the president, vice president, members of Congress, and senior executive branch officials from placing bets on prediction markets tied to government actions. Here's why: Prediction markets allow people to place bets on future events — elections, political decisions, even military actions. But members of Congress and senior government officials receive all sorts of sensitive briefings and confidential information as part of our jobs. **Allowing those same officials to place bets on events tied to government decisions creates a clear conflict of interest.** Recent activity on prediction markets has put this danger in the spotlight. One anonymous trader made more than $400,000 correctly predicting the removal of Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro before the news became public. Around the same time, suspicious trading surged around potential military strikes and global political events. These bets raise a serious question: who knew what — and when? No one serving the public should have the opportunity to profit from privileged information about government actions. Public service should never become a way to cash in on inside knowledge. It's corruption, plain and simple. Let's get this bill passed and bring some basic integrity to these betting platforms. _**by Dr. Eric Lullove, Medical Contributing Editor**_
We are often told that national security is measured in aircraft carriers, cyber-defense, and diplomatic summits. But as healthcare providers, we know a different metric: the stability of the supply chain that puts a lifesaving antibiotic in a patient's hand and the collective resilience of a society currently fraying at the edges.
The current geopolitical climate isn't just a matter of foreign policy; it is a clinical issue. It is a slow-motion stress test on our medical infrastructure that the public has yet to fully comprehend.
* * *
### **The View from the Bedside**
The first signs of national instability don't appear on a news ticker; they appear in the emergency room or exam room. As providers, we are the early warning system for the societal pulse.
Right now, the "bedside" is changing. We are seeing a distinct uptick in patients presenting with psychosomatic symptoms, exacerbations of chronic conditions, and a pervasive, low-grade anxiety that mimics physical trauma. When patients feel their world is becoming more dangerous or unpredictable, they stop adhering to long-term wellness plans. They prioritize immediate, short-term survival over long-term health, and they stop trusting the systems that are supposed to care for them.
The clinical reality is that the exam room is the only place where the abstract "national mood" manifests as a tangible diagnostic challenge. We are treating the symptoms of a nation that is holding its breath -- and sometimes it feels like it is on life support.
* * *
_**PLEASE HELP US BEAT THE FASCISTS, FOR JUST $3.30/MONTH**_
[ STOP TRUMP FOR ~$3/MONTH](https://substack.com/redirect/b9841c13-9423-4b63-87df-2c42c3bd666c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
### **The Opportunity Cost: Supply Chains and Material Shortages**
The most immediate danger posed by conflict is not just the disruption of trade routes--it is the catastrophic opportunity cost of prioritizing military logistics over medical ones.
Our global health infrastructure relies on a precise, "just-in-time" delivery system. When national energy and logistical focus shifts to a war footing, medical supply chains are frequently the first to experience "secondary status."
This leads to a systemic fragility that is difficult to quantify until it breaks:
* **The "Bullwhip Effect":** When shipping routes become contested, the costs of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and specialized medical equipment skyrocket, leading to price-gouging and availability gaps.
* **API Bottlenecks:** Many generic drugs and APIs are sourced from countries (like India) that rely heavily on trade routes passing through the Middle East. Increased insurance premiums, fuel costs, and diverted shipping lanes (adding thousands of miles to voyages) create a massive lag in lead times.
* **Logistics Inflation:** Air freight capacity is currently stretched thin. As pharmaceutical companies scramble to bypass maritime routes, the cost of air cargo has surged, putting immense pressure on supply chain margins and forcing prioritization of high-value cargo.
* **Raw Material Scarcity:** Beyond shipping, the conflict impacts energy and petrochemical markets. Many plastic, glass, and specialized polymer components used in medical packaging and devices are derived from petroleum. Price shocks in energy ripple directly into the cost and availability of these materials.
* **Component Dependency:** Many of the high-end materials we use in advanced procedures--from specialized dressings in wound care to delicate diagnostic components--rely on raw materials that are now caught in the crosshairs of geopolitical maneuvering.
* **Resource Compression:** Funding that could be directed toward health security, pandemic preparedness, or infrastructure modernization is redirected to immediate defense needs, leaving our domestic healthcare capacity hollowed out.
* * *

_**MIKE JOHNSON TRIED TO HELP TRUMP STEAL THE 2020 ELECTION. HE IS OPENLY TRYING AGAIN. SUBSCRIBE, HELP US STOP HIS ELECTION THEFT.**_
[ HELP US STOP MIKE JOHNSON & DONALD TRUMP](https://substack.com/redirect/b9841c13-9423-4b63-87df-2c42c3bd666c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
### **The Erosion of the Social Contract**
Perhaps the most damaging effect of this conflict-driven policy is the silent erosion of the social contract. The fundamental agreement between a state and its citizens is that the state will ensure their basic well-being. When "national security" is defined solely as the absence of external military threats, while the internal health of the population is neglected, that contract begins to dissolve.
Trust is a finite resource. When patients see that their health is treated as a secondary concern--when they cannot source their medications, when insurance and hospital administrators are forced to triage resources due to inflation, and when the healthcare workforce is treated as an afterthought--the trust in public health institutions craters. Failure to provide funding for the Affordable Care Act Subsidies and cutting $1 Billion USD from Medicaid complicates the trust that Americans have in our healthcare systems structure.
If we define security as the _total strength_ of a nation, then health _is_ national security. By diverting focus, resources, and administrative will away from the stability of our healthcare systems, we are not just failing to protect our citizens; we are dismantling the very foundations of the society we are trying to defend.
This is the untold story: The crisis isn't just in the headlines. It's in our clinics, our supply closets, and the faces of our patients.

| | | | | | Peter,
I wanted to share some exciting news: our campaign has officially qualified for the ballot for reelection to the LAUSD School Board.
As the **only Democrat in this race** , I’m ready to keep fighting for our students and the values we share.
I’m running for my third and final term on the School Board because LAUSD needs to continue making progress toward a stronger, more equitable future for our kids. As a new dad, that goal feels more personal than ever. I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished together despite the challenges over the last few years:
* Driving **record student achievement growth** while protecting the district’s finances
* Implementing the **largest cell phone ban in the country** to help kids focus and learn
* Leading the **largest expansion of preschool** in the state
* Passing two **record-breaking bond measures** to invest billions in our schools
* Launching **affordable housing for educators** on district land

But there’s still so much work to do and it’s important that we finish the work we’ve started. As our kids and communities face attacks from Washington, we need to continue to protect our vulnerable students while pushing achievement even higher and ensuring all kids, regardless of their background, have a fair shake.
[Will you chip in today to help us start this campaign strong?](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=7b2d0e1807&e=3cf484ad56)
Thank you for being part of this.

Hey folks,
**Katie Phang** and I went live again for another episode of **Breaking Bread** , and we started with something personal--how heavy the moment feels right now--and ended up in a pretty raw conversation about war, truth, and the people making life-and-death decisions from comfortable offices thousands of miles away. We talked about the reported bombing of a school in Iran, the administration's refusal to take responsibility, and Lindsey Graham basically volunteering _your_ kids for another war.
**Here 's what we got into:**
* **[00:01:07]** Katie opens up about the strange anxiety of living through unstable times -- how ordinary mornings can suddenly turn into history's worst days.
* **[00:07:50]** We break down the horrific school bombing in Iran and why the administration's explanation simply doesn't add up.
* **[00:12:00]** Katie questions whether Americans can trust anything coming from this administration anymore -- and why that erosion of trust is so dangerous.
* **[00:18:10]** The bigger problem: a world run by aging political leaders making decisions whose consequences they'll never have to live with.
* **[00:23:00]** Lindsey Graham suggests sending American sons and daughters to fight in Iran -- and we ask the obvious question: who exactly volunteered _him_ to decide that?

This episode is about more than one tragedy or one reckless statement. It's about a system where accountability feels optional, where the truth gets buried under spin, and where ordinary people -- here and abroad -- pay the price for decisions made by powerful men who will never see the fallout themselves.

subject: Two House Candidates You Need To Watch
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
JoAnna Mendoza and Jonathan Nez.
#

Team, it's Mark.
For all of us, taking back majorities in the House and Senate is incredibly important. It won’t be easy, though. The people running those races face a number of challenges. I know that all too well — my two campaigns for Senate were some of the most expensive in history.
It shouldn’t take millions and millions of dollars to run for Congress, but after Citizens United and the injection of unlimited donations from billionaires and corporate PACs, that’s the world we live in.
For my part, I’m going to do everything I can to level the playing field. So, today, I want to tell you about two candidates in Arizona that could determine which party controls the House next year.
JoAnna Mendoza and Jonathan Nez.
JoAnna is a former Marine Corps drill instructor, a single mom, and a critical voice for her community. She’s running in Arizona’s 6th Congressional District. Jonathan is the former President of the Navajo Nation, the largest tribe in the country. He’s running in Arizona’s 2nd Congressional District. Both are the exact kind of citizen leaders our country needs right now, and both have a really good chance of winning their races if they get the support they need.
We can make sure that happens, so I’m asking you to split a donation between both of their campaigns. **

That’s why I’ve taken on RFK Jr. for his radical conspiracy theories, his anti-vaccine platform, and his blatant attacks on Americans who live with disabilities. And I’ve stood up to Trump’s efforts to slash Medicaid and government services that the disability community relies on. Today, more than 70 million Americans report that they are living with a disability. body:
No one can win a fight like this on their own

These days in Donald Trump’s Administration, it feels like the wealthy and well-connected have more power, more influence in national politics than ever before — and no one’s fighting back. And in many ways, it’s true. But here in Pennsylvania? It’s a different story. **I’ve spent my life taking on powerful special interests in order to fight for the people of Pennsylvania — and winning.** I fired Wall Street money managers to save taxpayers and retirees millions of dollars in Montgomery County. As Attorney General, I stood up, brought powerful health care companies to the table, and protected care for millions of Pennsylvanians. As Governor, I’ve stood up to Donald Trump and the federal government after they broke their contracts and tried to screw over our Commonwealth — fighting in court time and again and securing billions of dollars rightfully owed to the good people of Pennsylvania. I’ll be honest: I’ve been in a lot of big fights throughout my life. But each and every time, I knew Pennsylvanians like you had my back. Baumtoberfest 2026 is just **three weeks away** , and I’m excited to share some great news about this year’s event.

Joining us as our **special guest** will be **Congressman Brad Knott** , one of the newest members of the Republican majority in the House and a strong voice for conservative leadership in Washington. Brad and I serve together on the **House Judiciary Committee** , where we’re working to restore accountability at the Department of Justice, strengthen border security, and defend the Constitution. I’m excited for our supporters here in Eastern Washington to hear directly from him about what’s really happening in Washington, D.C. and the work we’re doing to move the country in a better direction.
Baumtoberfest has become one of our campaign’s favorite traditions — **an evening where supporters come together to celebrate our progress and build momentum for the fights ahead.**
**Baumtoberfest 2026**
**Featuring Special Guest Congressman Brad Knott**
Monday, March 30, 2026
Spokane, WA
With the event taking place **just one day before our End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline** , Baumtoberfest will be an important moment for our campaign as we head into the next phase of 2026.
Last year’s event **sold out** , and tickets are already moving quickly.
If you’re planning to attend, I encourage you to **purchase your ticket or reserve your table today before we sell out.**

**About Congressman Brad Knott**
Congressman Brad Knott represents North Carolina’s 13th Congressional District. Before being elected to Congress, Brad served as a federal prosecutor in the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of North Carolina, where he focused on prosecuting violent crime, drug trafficking, and public corruption. Earlier in his career, he clerked for federal judges and worked in private law practice.
In Congress, Brad serves on the **House Judiciary Committee** and the **House Budget Committee** , where he is working to restore accountability in Washington, strengthen border security, support law enforcement, and address the nation’s growing debt.

body:
Friend,
I want to share the speech they called "divisive."
Then I want you to tell me what part offended them.
At our community's Tet Parade, I stood before my neighbors — not just as an elected official, but as a grateful refugee, a proud Vietnamese American, a wife, and a mother of three boys who calls this community home.
I said Tết is our story. The story of parents who fled communism with nothing but faith. Families who crossed oceans for freedom. Courage to start over. Courage to raise children in liberty. **Courage to stand for faith, family, and freedom.**
I told them about my family's escape in 1985. How we hid in the bottom of my father's fishing boat. How we did not know what tomorrow would hold — but we trusted God.
**And God brought us to America.**
"Psalm 33:12 says, 'Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord.' America is not perfect — but America is blessed because our rights come from God, not from government."
I talked about the Fire Horse — this year's symbol of strength, passion, and boldness. I told them: the Fire Horse does not stand still. And neither do we.
I asked the question our community already knows the answer to:
_What kind of America are we leaving our children? An America where faith is silenced? Or an America where faith is celebrated? An America where government controls our lives? Or an America where families lead with freedom?_
I said our community knows what happens when government becomes too powerful. We escaped that system. And we will never allow it to take root here.
I closed by saying: _as long as we stand together — in faith, in family, and in freedom — the best days of America are still ahead._
**That is the speech they labeled divisive.**
They demanded I apologize for it. I refused. So they voted to ban me from speaking at any future city events.
Think about that. A city council — in the heart of Little Saigon, in a community built by refugees who fled government tyranny — voted to silence an elected official for quoting Scripture and saying God bless America.
My family did not survive three days on open water to come to a country where politicians punish you for your faith.
**I will not apologize. I will not be quiet. The Fire Horse does not stand still.**

We lost the last election by 653 votes. They know we are close. And they are making clear they will use every tool at their disposal to silence this campaign before it gains momentum.
But here is what they do not understand: you cannot silence a community that survived communism. You cannot shame someone into apologizing for quoting the Bible. And you cannot stop a Fire Horse.

We have been preparing for weeks and are asking you right now for your urgent help to fund rapid evacuation capability, medical response, logistics, open source intelligence (OSINT), assets on the ground, and strategic planning, support, and assistance in order to provide life-saving humanitarian relief. This is Dennis Price. I'm a Marine Special operator and private military contractor with over 15 deployments who now leads rescue operations, humanitarian and medical aid – all led by the Holy Spirit “to free the oppressed, so others may live.” Since 2022, I've been the founder and leader of Heroes for Humanity – a network of special operators, veterans, first responders, medical professionals, and everyday people committed to being the hands and feet of Jesus. We were born in the chaos of Afghanistan's fall in 2021 – where I personally helped evacuate 77 Americans and vetted Afghan allies, even swimming the Panjshir River behind enemy lines to pull people out. And just the other day, we rescued 8 families from the chaos and violence in Mexico. But our story goes much deeper than even that. In 2022, we deployed to Ukraine for nine months during the invasion, delivered medical aid to orphanages , supported 65 wounded veterans , and ran precision rescues and logistics. And between 2023 and 2025, we rescued trafficked children stateside (including a 12-year-old trapped 45 days in California and a 16-year-old in Virginia), aided persecuted Christians in China , responded to the Texas floods and hurricanes in North Carolina and Florida , evacuated 92 American families from Israel during the 12-Day War, and provided aid after earthquakes and crises in Thailand, Burma, Cuba, Zambia, and more. As you can see, we've been busy all across the globe, but right now our only focus is getting Americans out of harm's way in the Middle East where things can go very wrong very quickly. Lives hang in the balance and you can make the difference. Beyond your support, we ask for prayer, wisdom, protection for the innocent, and strength for those making difficult decisions. Our mission remains clear:protect the vulnerable, serve with integrity, and act with faith. Thank you for your time, and further updates will be provided as the security environment allows. Respectfully submitted, Dennis Price CEO & Founder Heroes for Humanity “In order for evil to prevail, good men must stand by and do nothing.” | SERVING THE VULNERABLE. SHARING THE GOSPEL CHANGING LIVES. Heroes for Humanity 4200 Research Forest Dr, Suite 500 The Woodlands, TX 77381 EIN: 88-1104442

# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240739%2E444211%2EenO6sm)
You probably get a lot of fundraising emails from groups promising to help elect Democrats or to “stop Donald Trump.” You might wonder where the money goes.
**That’s not Powered by People.**
The money we raise is used to support organizers and volunteers who are meeting Texas voters wherever they are – schools, concerts, clubs, outside of churches – across 254 counties.
We verify every voter’s registration and register those not yet on the rolls. And in every instance, we personally stay in touch with those voters from now through the November election.
We measure our work, the impact that it has and the results that it helps produce.
For example, in 2024 our volunteers met nearly 30,000 young Texans who we helped to register and then personally texted and called to keep them on top of everything they needed to vote. When Early Voting started, we nudged them until we confirmed they’d cast their ballots. In a state where young people turn out at a rate of 37% our voters turned out at a rate over 79%.
_Just last week_ Beto and our organizers and volunteers were on the ground at Texas Southern University, the University of Texas at Austin, Texas A&M, **and** the University of Houston to register college students to vote and stay in touch with them through November. This is the work that works.
Our goal is to mobilize 100,000 additional voters before the midterms, help elect James Talarico to the U.S. Senate, and ensure Democrats down the ballot have the voters they need to win.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Congress is unserious. Delaware isn’t.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Things don’t have to be this way. And I’m working every day to prove it.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2928%2E21716%2EA0aoMu)
I wish I could tell you that Congress was working the way it should be.
But you’ve seen the clips. You’ve read the news. And you’ve witnessed the politicians who are more focused on viral moments than legislation.
**Congress is – in many ways – _a sh*t show._**
In a minute, I’m going to explain why. [**But if you’re tired of this circus, I’m asking you to donate $5 to my re-election campaign today.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260310-1.8H4EUm&refcode=em20260310-2928&amount=5&t=2&akid=2928%2E21716%2EA0aoMu)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260310-1.8H4EUm&amount=5&refcode=em20260310-2928&t=3&akid=2928%2E21716%2EA0aoMu)**
We’ve all felt the effects of a government that focuses on useless conversations and culture wars while ignoring the real issues affecting Americans.
This feels like reality television. Without the fun, but all the drama.
**But it doesn’t have to be this way.**
I’ve always believed that Congress is an important place and an important collection of people with the power to do good for working families, our democracy, and for communities across the nation, like ours in Delaware.
I take my job _very seriously_ and am working every day to deliver on my promises.
In the Delaware State Senate, I didn't go to Dover for a title – I went for a job. As chair of the Health & Social Services Committee, I worked across the aisle to pass paid family and medical leave and expand access to healthcare for the working people that need it most.
This is the kind of meaningful work that _should_ be happening in Congress. But what I’m actually seeing are cries for attention. Not giving others room to speak. Doing nothing to actually make people’s lives better.
**The stakes are too high for this not to change.** Let’s start by electing serious, substantive candidates that know how to use their office to deliver for their constituents.
I can’t do it alone: [**Will you contribute $5, $10, or whatever you can afford today to help prove that Congress can still work for the people it's supposed to serve?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260310-1.8H4EUm&refcode=em20260310-2928&t=4&akid=2928%2E21716%2EA0aoMu)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260310-1.8H4EUm&amount=5&refcode=em20260310-2928&t=23&akid=2928%2E21716%2EA0aoMu)**
Thank you for standing with me.
Sarah McBride

name: Deb Haaland
subject: My life experiences have always impacted and shaped my policies throughout my career
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=8106%2E400544%2E4D4DMu)
---
Friend, I've said it before and I'll say it again: I am of and for New Mexico.

Like many New Mexicans, I've faced challenges — like homelessness and financial insecurity — but that’s also why I am the best person for the job, **[and as governor of our beautiful state, I'm ready to move us toward a future where everyone can thrive.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6189?t=2&akid=8106%2E400544%2E4D4DMu)**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6189?t=3&akid=8106%2E400544%2E4D4DMu)
---
My lived experiences have always shaped how I lead and the policies I fight for, friend.

When my mother became pregnant, she was serving in the military, and she was forced out. Just like that, her career ended. I still think about what her path might have looked like if she had been given the chance to keep serving.

That stays with me.

It’s why, in Congress, I worked to remove barriers for women in uniform through the National Defense Authorization Act. And it’s why I helped pass the bipartisan Rent the Camo bill to create a maternity uniform bank for pregnant service members.

[I know that my struggles, community, and lived experiences will continue shaping my policies as governor of New Mexico.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6189?t=4&akid=8106%2E400544%2E4D4DMu) Take a look:
* As a child, I spent my weekends fishing and running through the desert with my cousins, and that's why I'm looking to create an **Every Child Outdoor Initiative** to improve academic performance, student engagement, and sense of community.

* My child learned to read in kindergarten, and I saw firsthand how that shaped her education onward. With support from teachers, parents, and students, I have a **plan to help all of New Mexico's kids succeed that starts by getting them to read earlier.**

* I know what it's like to be a single mother working multiple jobs and struggling to make ends meet. **As governor, I will advocate for and protect universal childcare and increase the Child Tax Credit.**

* In high school, I saw people around me get opportunities and real jobs right after graduation — and I want to start that process even earlier. I will **expand career pathways starting in middle school** , so we can cultivate the next generation of skilled trades workers.

**I'm running for governor because I understand that success feels out of reach for many families in our state, but I also know we can change that.[ Please, if you believe in my vision for a brighter New Mexico, chip in $5 or whatever you can spare now.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6189?t=5&akid=8106%2E400544%2E4D4DMu)**

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter,

I'm Adam Schwarze, _**a former Navy SEAL,**_ Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan. As a combat veteran who deployed nine times to defend our nation, putting my life on the line so families like yours could sleep safely, I'm writing to ask for your support in my run for U.S. Senate.

_****Please do me the personal favor of reading this note all the way to the end; I put a lot of time and effort into it.****_

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=33399178558242b0bb74f0df60865767&_e=2UkHrgQa7uENClsygyEBEizYWeEB1SUDDzEx3mnkBkehPS2LX3auKQ7T7u592MNF-7TOQf-L-Mm7m7loMYwkNlJ2LqSIhdfpvfWu46HiN2YrlDL2Juapg1aCKm7Cu_h1MM52NOHXBS4of2ErgBQ5zihYZbJAfxjvZcJa79Jw1fAlBCqHiZxQRV9lSaq-qrJuwSj8Dc86qV2CroYYQW2gxO4eIu-_UpXLO9XT2ci9Q8alfPpYFHW1sXZKIS5xFktmOCcjSh5VMr7Q5zOqqA8ucE3i4Wqg5Iol0AGEIgE_bsi3kP3BMN_LfSst_uGLAJySDKNTZWIyApkdUTfQumq64vdyT5TAslhq-XbmecLQ84s799s4EXNe2yA3DIO-quGU0BLhU0DL6mYeJf1j4Bzmf1LBW2W42jbm4ELoPSvkbumabngQ112-qpa6VZZNwzZM4wiUWmRJUOiJ1W2z1iO0V_mK5ihtMpXQKdkA6yiMCiFNeStF0zkzO2CqHkQ1mghM028Ru6xiNAXzMnaIOrwAQ5CL0rfQ0WQlLdbebVDL8p9DhEDua-jdM3ap_CyHXuRaMRTgJBDe1dBa2QoVZfhX-XR1-BkualG-WhHi-i5qP3-9sdpBJw83PLPhA3eJJ99gmwlwJlFacTLKN73ezvb7CfGTEjxFUGVohHyFgMpPoLtqg9TCNj2TsTjISes5_l142-A2QsoGR3fLQtKhr6YBgOQQWfe2cbKjfnC93kL1dxAbEj8ImdK-OEyPtHQ4zuDa)

_**If you're not from Minnesota, that's OK—keep reading. The radical policies hurting our communities here under Tim Walz and his allies are spreading nationwide, perhaps even to your backyard.**_

Our neighborhoods aren't what they were when I grew up in the '80s and '90s.

Would you let your kids or grandkids play outside unsupervised for hours today? Those days feel like a distant memory now—but they shouldn’t be.

**Americans deserve communities where children can play without fear of criminal illegal immigrants or violent chaos fueled by weak policies put into place by radical Democrats.
**
**For his part, President Trump is delivering real progress:** strong borders, backing the blue, and decisive action against threats. And right now, we have a strong Republican majority in the Senate standing up to support him.

But maybe not for long...

Not only is President Trump working to make our homeland safer through his support for increased police presence and zero tolerance for criminal behavior, but he’s also taking the fight to our enemies abroad in a show of immense strength. **As you know, Trump is leading a bold effort to confront the terrorist regime in Iran—because real leaders don't back down from tyrants. Peter,

While the rise in popularity of politicians like Zohran Mamdani and his socialist policies might have come as a shock to many, I've been warning people about it for years.

Younger Americans do not know what socialism means.

When younger Americans think of "socialism," they think it means Sweden and Denmark.

They didn't grow up during the Cold War. They don't remember the Soviet Union. Or Stalin's Gulags or the Warsaw Pact. They couldn't even tell you what the initials U.S.S.R. stood for, or that Nazi is the abbreviation of National Socialist.

**Young Americans need to hear about socialism, real socialism, from someone who experienced it firsthand. I can think of no one better than Ayn Rand.**

Rand wrote novels like _We The Living_ , which dramatized the inhumanity of the Soviet system -- and most importantly, _Atlas Shrugged_ , which dramatized what would happen if socialism came to America. Rand's immense success in making the moral case for capitalism led my friend, the late Ed Crane, to call her "the greatest all-time recruiter for the liberty movement."

The challenge is that young people simply aren't reading novels anymore. In the 70s, 70% of young people read fiction daily for fun -- today, less than 12% do.

That's where The Atlas Society comes in. They bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for new audiences in innovative ways, including animated videos, viral social media, graphic novels -- even music videos. Plus online courses and live events.

I told Jennifer Grossman, The Atlas Society's CEO, that I would help her raise $30,000 online this month to introduce more young minds to Ayn Rand's ideas.

clean_body: Peter, While the rise in popularity of politicians like Zohran Mamdani and his socialist policies might have come as a shock to many, I've been warning people about it for years. Younger Americans do not know what socialism means. When younger Americans think of "socialism," they think it means Sweden and Denmark. They didn't grow up during the Cold War. They don't remember the Soviet Union. Or Stalin's Gulags or the Warsaw Pact. They couldn't even tell you what the initials U.S.S.R. stood for, or that Nazi is the abbreviation of National Socialist. Young Americans need to hear about socialism, real socialism, from someone who experienced it firsthand. I can think of no one better than Ayn Rand. Rand wrote novels like We The Living , which dramatized the inhumanity of the Soviet system -- and most importantly, Atlas Shrugged , which dramatized what would happen if socialism came to America. Rand's immense success in making the moral case for capitalism led my friend, the late Ed Crane, to call her "the greatest all-time recruiter for the liberty movement." The challenge is that young people simply aren't reading novels anymore. In the 70s, 70% of young people read fiction daily for fun -- today, less than 12% do. That's where The Atlas Society comes in. They bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for new audiences in innovative ways, including animated videos, viral social media, graphic novels -- even music videos. Plus online courses and live events. I told Jennifer Grossman, The Atlas Society's CEO, that I would help her raise $30,000 online this month to introduce more young minds to Ayn Rand's ideas. Otherwise, please let me explain why I believe The Atlas Society and its leadership are best suited to combat the rise in popularity of these harmful ideologies. First, Jennifer and I go back more than 35 years, when she was a White House Speechwriter, and Americans for Tax Reform was in its founding era. She's one of the most innovative, effective, and persevering executives I know. Over the past decade, she's built The Atlas Society into a juggernaut for freedom. The Atlas Society is the ONLY non-profit adapting Rand 's works into media that appeals to young Americans. Just one example: their animated book trailer for Atlas Shrugged drew 12 million views, and DOUBLED sales of the novel! They're currently producing a full-length feature film of Anthem, Rand's dystopian novella. I believe in their great work because I've seen the impact they've had. It's why I've collaborated with The Atlas Society on various discussions and interviews, including speaking at their student conferences, doing interviews on their podcast, and even doing stand-up comedy at one of their fundraising galas! Thank you, Grover Norquist P.S. If you still aren't convinced, let me tell you what will happen if young Americans fail to learn these important lessons. body:
The New York Times just put a number on it
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260310-2595)
Peter,
It's that time again — Two-Dollar Tuesday! Yes it's a fun slogan, yes it's an easy, accessible way to support the campaign. But it's also a statement about who this campaign belongs to — not billionaires, not corporate PACs. You.
Yesterday, The New York Times [reported](https://act.francescahong.com/go/5227?t=1&akid=2595%2E105371%2E2wYldW) that just 300 billionaire families made up 19% of all federal campaign donations in 2024. Three hundred families out of a country of 330 million people? That's an oligarchy, folks.
Each one gave an average of $10 million — the equivalent of 100,000 regular donors. And that's just what we can see — it doesn't count the dark money they funnel through groups that never have to disclose a dime.
Just twenty years ago, billionaires accounted for 0.3% of campaign spending. Now it's 19%. That's a takeover of our democracy by the elite.
For every dollar they gave to Democrats, five went to Republicans. And right here in Wisconsin, they turned last year's Supreme Court race into the most expensive judicial election in American history.
The governor's race is next. They're coming. And that money will be used against us.
**[If everyone reading this chipped in $2 right now, the impact would be huge.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260310.OgEAHo&refcode=em20260310-2595&t=2&akid=2595%2E105371%2E2wYldW)**
Your donation gets us on the road to meet voters. It lets us hire dedicated campaign staffers who believe in our mission. It helps us print yard signs and posters. Every dollar you give goes toward building the kind of campaign that can fight for universal childcare, paid leave, affordable healthcare, and an economy that works for everyone, not just the people who can write six-figure checks.
Here’s a cute dog as a token of my gratitude.

With gratitude,
Fran

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter – you’re probably receiving tons of messages like this from other candidates and organizations asking for your support right now. But if you’ll give me just one minute, I want to explain why **your donation of $5 will go further here than in any other race in the country.**
1️⃣ I’m running against a far-right Trump ally who’s a threat to our future.
While I believe that the highest duty of elected officials is to serve the best interests of the people they represent, my opponent, Michael Whatley, is in this fight to serve Donald Trump and help enact his extreme MAGA agenda.
2️⃣ North Carolina will decide Senate control.
Experts say there’s no path for Democrats to retake the majority without flipping this seat blue. **Winning here is the only way we can break the GOP’s grip on power.**
3️⃣ Super PACs and dark-money groups are pouring millions into this race to defeat me.
**Far-right Republicans know I'm the biggest threat to their hold on the Senate majority – and that’s why this race is set to be the most expensive Senate race in history.**
Unlike my far-right opponent, I’m building a grassroots campaign that relies on people like you chipping in what you can, when you can. **[Will you chip in $5 today to flip this seat blue and have an outsized impact on our fight to take back the Senate and return power to the people?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6977?t=7&akid=730%2E124072%2EL-VhuP)**
| | [CHIP IN](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6975?t=8&akid=730%2E124072%2EL-VhuP)

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

body:
Hi – my name is Nancy Lacore, and I’m running for Congress in SC-01.
For years, Nancy Mace has put her own personal ambition ahead of South Carolinians. Instead of delivering for the folks who elected her, she’s more concerned with political theater and national headlines.
After 35 years of serving our country in the Navy, I’m running because I believe South Carolina’s First deserves leadership that’s focused on the real challenges people face every day.
But here’s the truth about this race, folks: the first weeks matter most. The sooner we can get the word out and reach voters where they are, the better our momentum will be on Election Day. Will you split a $20 or $45 donation between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
Nancy Mace has spent her time in Congress chasing attention instead of solutions – changing her positions when it’s suited her and turning the struggles of South Carolina families into political bargaining chips. That kind of damage won’t just disappear on its own.
That’s why I’m answering the call to serve, NAME. I’ll bring the focus back to where it belongs: on integrity, service, and the everyday challenges facing South Carolinians. We can restore integrity to this seat, deliver accountable leadership, and finally make the government work for people.
But we need all hands on deck to make it right. If we wait, we risk losing out on this opportunity and giving it to yet another grifting career politician.
This is our chance to build something better for South Carolina. I’m ready to step up and do the work, but I need you to join me. Will you split a donation of $20 or more between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]

With my deepest respect and gratitude,
Nancy Lacore
Democrat for Congress

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: Difficult decisions
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
Here’s the situation in Georgia.
#

Peter, my team and I have some difficult decisions coming up, and we could really use a hand, particularly right now.
The end of this month marks our first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline of the year. And after it passes, we’re going to sit down and make some plans for the weeks and months ahead.
**I want to give the green light to the biggest, boldest plans my team can think up.** Plans that will reach every corner of the state and get everyone involved and talking to their neighbors. _Plans that will win Georgia._
But Peter, running a campaign like that is not easy. _Especially when we’re already facing millions of dollars in outside Republican spending._ In order to fully respond to my opponents’ attacks and organize relentlessly across the state, we are going to need your help.
This team has never let me down before. In 2021, I won election to the U.S. Senate by just over 1%. _It was close!_ But thanks to you, we had the resources to win. So, ahead of some important budget decisions for our campaign, I’m asking for your help once again:
**[Please, chip in $5 or whatever you can afford to my reelection campaign today. We’ll put every donation right to work building the best campaign we possibly can — there’s too much on the line for anything less than maximum effort.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em260310-2-f&t=1&akid=1818%2E5691347%2E3MQzNr)
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em260310-2-f&t=2&akid=1818%2E5691347%2E3MQzNr)**
Thank you so much for your support. Onward!
Jon Ossoff
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em260310-2-f&t=3&akid=1818%2E5691347%2E3MQzNr)

Hi null,

I’ve spent my career fighting for Michigan families. And with the help of this grassroots team, we’ve made incredible progress:
* I introduced the Stop Trump’s Abuse of Power Act after Trump illegally sent the military into U.S. cities.

* I led the charge to bring semiconductor manufacturing back to Michigan.

* I introduced the No Tariffs on Groceries Act to help bring down prices at the checkout line.

* I filed articles of impeachment against RFK Jr. for putting lives at risk and undermining public health.

I know there’s still more work to do in 2026 and beyond. That’s why I’m running for Senate. And as I fight for every corner of Michigan, I want to make sure this campaign reflects the issues that matter most to you, null.

**Your priorities are my priorities.** So before I hit the trail again, I hope you’ll take just a minute to fill out this quick 2026 Priorities Survey. **_[I need your response by midnight, so I know what's important to you:](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/15182?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=4&akid=2423%2E49239%2EpUQziX)_**

[**Republicans are already hard at work, attacking Democrats to prevent us from winning races across the country this year and beyond. Now, it’s on _all of us_ to make sure they don’t go unchecked.
